critic.quote: World Brothers 2 provides excellent upgrades to mechanics from the first game to make this one feel even better to play.

I’m absolutely a fan of the spin-off, with World Brothers 2 carrying on the quick, accessible, and nonsensically entertaining action of its predecessor. It’s packed full of fun toys, drowns the player in content, and you can play as a woman who thinks she’s a horse.  She spawns carrots behind her when she sprints. How is that not what videogames are all about?

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is a bit of a mixed bag. It probably has the best gameplay in the series, but loses some of the scope and campiness of the mainline games. Also, the timing of its release is weird, coming out only 2 months after Earth Defense Force 6. While I reviewed the PS5 version of World Brothers 2, and found it ran beautifully, at the time of preorder, the Switch version

In a series that is quickly running out of fresh ideas, World Brothers 2 leans into being fast, fun and cheery. It might struggle to find an audience with both casual players and hardcore EDF fans but it certainly offers up some enjoyable alien blasting action.

While it's not all that different from its predecessor, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 proves to be a worthy follow-up, offering more missions and more Brothers to collect, and ultimately just being more fun in general. Whether you're an existing fan of the series or want a fun way to dip your toes into it, World Brothers 2 is easy to recommend.
World Brothers 2 is a great introductory title for those new to EDF, as well as longtime fans looking for a more straightforward experience that allows for quicker experimentation.

critic.quote: This definitive remaster elevates an already legendary ARPG to modern heights, showcasing jaw-dropping path tracing, refined animations, and smarter enemy combat. Although movement still carries a slight lingering clunkiness and initial load times remain protracted, the comprehensive mechanical tweaks and bundled expansions make this return to the Continent an absolute masterpiece.

The question isn't whether The Witcher 3 Remastered can still compete in 2026. The real question is which comparable game of the last ten years can go toe-to-toe with it, and that is a very short list.

Without a doubt, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered is the best way to revisit The Witcher 3. It is beautiful, polished, still packed with timeless content, and comes as a free upgrade. The Witcher still has a story that holds up remarkably well today and a world worth exploring, and its quality has always made it better equipped than most games to withstand the passage of time.

The Witcher 3 Remastered doesn’t make the massive RPG feel like a new game, but it does tweak and enhance a number of facets that help smooth over the experience and bring out its best qualities. It’s a fascinating way to return to the shoes of Geralt of Rivia.

The greatest strength of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered is that it gives us an excuse to step back into the shoes of Geralt of Rivia on his journey across the Continent. Years later, it remains thrilling to wield both the steel and silver swords, and this time CD PROJEKT RED delivers an updated, smoother, and more modern combat system. The visuals have been overhauled—particularly the light

We are talking about The Witcher 3, complete with its two excellent DLCs: Blood and Wine, which is richer in terms of content, and Hearts of Stone, which is more artistically striking. The remastering work is polished, save for a few minor hiccups—mostly involving the menus. It is truly hard to pass up, especially considering we need to get ready for Songs of the Past.

critic.quote: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla is another success in the series. We love that it’s starting to look back at older, more classic elements of the franchise and finding ways to reimplement them in an ever-evolving, fresh feeling new game.

Assassin's Creed Valhalla takes the advancements of the series found in Odyssey and applies it to a whole new setting. As brutal as the period of Vikings is, there's something beautiful about this adventure. Every action is rewarded with some great moments of storytelling, and aside from a few narrative roadblocks tied to the player's level, there's an amazing world here just waiting to be discove

If it sufficiently renews the experience of the saga thanks to a rich and functional overall design and an approach that should delight fans of the first hour, Assassin's Creed Valhalla also retains some stigmas of its predecessors that prevent it from aiming a little higher.

It is undeniable that the series is growing, and it’s admirable that the developers are willing to try new things. Overall, the experience works in Assassin’s Creed Valhalla. It’s not a perfect fit, yet, but there’s promise in the series future if they continue to head in a direction that has more RPG elements, and options for a direct approach. It also feels like a proof of concept that they can

Those are minor nitpicks of course, and shouldn't take away from all of the things Valhalla does well. Beautiful, rich in content, varied in what it offers, The Crew Motorfest is a very good 100% arcade open world racing game. 新特工、新威胁、新史诗战役
《Sniper Elite: Resistance》提供无与伦比的狙击机制、潜行和第三人称战术战斗，将这一获奖系列的关注点转向了一场远离前线、深入被占领的法国腹地的隐秘战争。
在与《Sniper Elite 5》并行展开的扣人心弦的新故事中，特别行动执行处(SOE)的特工哈里·霍克首次担任主角，他发现了一种阴险的新型奇迹武器——这种武器威力强大，足以确保纳粹赢得战争。
与法国反抗军合作，势必摧毁帝国武器库中的这一致命武器。
多个暗杀名单目标以及不同的潜入和撤离点为你提供了无与伦比的选择权，让你自由决定如何完成目标并创造出自己的游戏风格。
整个战役也可以在合作模式下进行。与盟友一起对抗纳粹战争机器，分享武器、物品和战术知识，并在交火中倒下时互相帮助重新投入战斗。
逼真的X射线击杀镜头和先进的枪战物理效果

要成功击中目标，你需要像真正的狙击手一样思考。在瞄准目标时，要考虑步枪枪托和枪管的选择，同时还要考虑重力、风和心率。
真实的二战武器和自定义
你可以使用的武器库将包括回归的系列游戏热门武器，以及一系列全新的二战真实武器。挑选合适的装备对于粉碎帝国的邪恶计划至关重要！

轴心国入侵模式
广受喜爱的轴心国入侵模式回归了！以轴心国狙击手的身份入侵其他玩家的战役，参与致命的猫捉老鼠游戏。无论你是跟踪猎物、设下埋伏还是在枪林弹雨中奔跑，入侵的威胁都会为战役带来全新的挑战维度。
紧张的在线多人游戏

critic.quote: Sniper Elite: Resistance is here, and it's not reinventing the wheel. It is the same craft that we've seen, with a more cheerful protagonist, in different locales. But that's not a bad thing, as Rebellion have only striven to improve the head-popping formula that they clearly care about. Another trip back behind enemy lines, Resistance is just as fun as any of the Sniper Elite's before it.

Sniper Elite: Resistance delivers more of the excellent tactical stealth shooting action that Sniper Elite 5 boasted three years ago. It might be a familiar experience, but for genre fans, it's still an easy recommendation.

Packed with that familiar caliber of intriguing level design and emergent gameplay, Sniper Elite: Resistance may not be the most radical of changes, but it undoubtedly makes up for it in its retaining the series’ joyous curating of tactile shots and careful planning alike.

Sniper Elite: Resistance is a reasonable continuation of the franchise, its sniping highs remain as amusing as ever thanks to some neat environmental gameplay, but much of its content rehashes what came before instead of evolving the series concept for a true next-gen sequel.

Resistance doesn’t introduce any major innovations, but it once again delivers a solid mix of action and mission planning, which is the Rebellion’s winning formula. However, the series can no longer rely solely on its signature cinematic kills to stay relevant. A general refresh, including technical improvements, is becoming necessary before the franchise risks slipping into a nostalgic more of th

Sniper Elite: Resistance serves as more of a stopgap than a full-blown sequel to Sniper Elite 5, so much of that experience — including its highs and lows — carries over two and a half years later. Its sniping action truly is elite, but the gunplay surrounding it still needs work. Equally, the Invasion Mode is again a standout while enemy AI remains frustrating at times. It is more of the same. critic.quote: Destiny 2 is an epic: a story with an ever expanding scale made greater by the heroes of whom the story is told with tragedy, struggle, and redemption. It is very fitting that the score to accompany it must be, too. And it is. There were moments that I had to put the controller down and simply listen, taking in the scope of what I was experiencing.

Lessons were learnt and learnt well. The looming Darkness has not consumed Bungie at this point in time. Quite the contrary. Destiny 2 is the glorious self-rez fans have been praying for. Stop orbiting it and dive in, today.
Destiny 2 improves upon its predecessor in every conceivable area, resulting in a content-packed, enjoyable FPS that will keep you entertained for months on end.

There’s a lot to enjoy here both solo and as a co-op experience. Any fan of Destiny 1 should take a look at this game, and anyone that has had interest in it but hasn’t pulled the trigger on it just yet should rest easy knowing that while it has a few issues here and there, Destiny 2 is a great game that champions over the first game in so many ways. I highly suggest it to both FPS and RPG fans al

Although Destiny 2 requires quite a lot of grinding, the whole process doesn't really feel like a chore since there are so many varied activities that you'll rarely do the same thing twice in a month (unless it's a weekly activity, or you really want to). First and foremost, Destiny 2 does not frustrate players by placing parts of the end game under hard to achieve power level requirements. There'

The story and gameplay mechanics have greatly improved, and it sports many graphical upgrades. It's unfortunate that the enemy AI isn't more challenging, but for this franchise, the fun will always come from the end-game content. As long as players understand and accept that, they should snap up this sequel and prepare for another long adventure.

critic.quote: The Ground Forces expansion makes War Thunder even bigger than it was already, an MMO F2P that lets you choose the war you want: simulation or arcade, air or ground, challenging or relaxing, competitive or cooperative, free or with fee, PC or PS4.

War Thunder surprised me. I am not very good at it, but I still have a lot of fun playing it. Because it is a free-to-play game, some players will download it on a whim and quit 20 minutes in due to the poor controls. Those that brave the steep learning curve will be rewarded with a realistic combat simulator that could be truly great one day.

War Thunder is easily among the best of what is offered on the PlayStation Store. It stands head and shoulders above the other free to play offerings and even over many at cost. The core of this lies in the generous free to play model which allows you to play for hour and hours without paying a dime. Though microtransactions were disabled in the pre-release version, I did get to explore the store
War Thunder delivers a deep, engaging experience, packed with plenty of missions and planes to unlock.

War Thunder has some issues here and there, but it’s a very competent flying and ground war game that doesn’t let its microtransaction component get in the way. There’s plenty of tanks and planes to try out and modify to your liking, and just enough visuals to enjoy along the way. It’s not perfect, but it’s a solid game.
Easy to get into, difficult to master, and free as a bird. Definitely sample-worthy. [February 2014, p79]

s.desc:
通过重装上阵版和免费的《猩红纽带》DLC，获得更为丰富的《消逝的光芒2 人与仁之战》体验。请注意：DLC必须单独下载。
距离第一部游戏的故事已经过去了20年，病毒占了上风，人类正逐渐走向灭亡。你将扮演艾登·克拉德威尔，一个流浪漫游者，负责运送货物和传递消息，在被丧尸病毒摧毁的荒芜世界中，保持着与仅存的几个生存者聚居点的联系。然而，你的真正目标是找到妹妹米娅。为了逃离华尔兹医生的痛苦实验，你曾经离开了还是孩童的她。这段过去一直在你心中挥之不去。当你听说米娅可能还活着，并且居住在地球上最后一座城市维勒多时，你终于下定决心直面这一切。
不久后，你发现自己身处一个冲突不断的定居点。你需要参与新奇而残酷的战斗，不断磨砺自己的技能，击败成群的丧尸，并与其他人结盟。你将在城市中漫游，在维勒多的建筑和屋顶上自由奔跑，搜寻偏远地区的战利品，并在夜晚时保持警惕。每当太阳西沉，怪物就会占领所有街道。
末日后的世界
15年前，人类经历了一场大陷落，这场灾难永远改变了世界。到了2036年，只有为数不多的定居点存留于世，而人类正在逐渐走向灭亡，为无情的新物种——成群结队的丧尸——让路。
白天属于活人，夜晚属于感染者
白天，生存者仍然努力在这里生活，表面上看，一切似乎……不错。然而，当日落时分到来，一旦阳光消失，城市中更可怕的居民将占领街道。如果你在黑暗中停留太久，不提高警惕，就可能永远无法回家。
移动不止，生命不息
你不可能赢得所有的战斗。有时候，逃跑才是上策。幸运的是，你正好有这样的技巧。当你陷入危机，跑酷会让你顺利逃脱。在屋顶间跳跃，飞荡着穿过不同的城市景观等等。只要确保能够逃离夜晚的怪物。
残暴一点，再玩得花一点
在这个危险的世界中，只有最强者才能生存。无论你是喜欢粉碎、切割还是肢解任何挡在你面前的敌人，记得要发挥创造力！结合战斗和跑酷的方式抵御任何形式的危险，一切为了活命。
与其单打独斗，不如四个漫游者同行
有朋友相助，在维勒多活下去会更容易。与最多3名玩家组队，以增加你的生存几率。一起探索剧情，接受漫游者哨站的挑战，或是在城市街道上大肆破坏。

s.desc:
在这款拥有超高自定义自由度的、任务制的刷宝射击游戏中，杀穿真菌异形吧！数以百计精心设计的升级项，支持四人合作游玩，甚至还有一个小蟑螂人呢。如何能不爱呢？
一群被淘汰的机器人被赛克森公司招募，获得了最后一次证明自己的机会——赢得荣誉并挣个盆满钵满（顺便也就不用被丢进废品堆了）。作为临时拼凑的灭菌小队——“新阿特拉斯危害处理小队”，他们受命调查一场席卷整个星球的真菌灾难背后的秘密。
深入危险的星球任务，全力抵抗这场真菌浩劫。这真的只是他们所声称的一场自然灾害吗？话说赛克森公司真的弄错了你的税务申报吗？还是你自己搞砸了？
真菌克星
从一系列超前卫的未来科幻武器（以及一些工具）中精挑细选，然后使用独一无二的网格式升级系统对它们进行超级强化，打造你梦寐以求的科幻超级武器。
横扫千菌
消灭蜂拥而至的敌人，它们会腐化星球上的科技，将其化作武器来对付你。逐个击破这些怪物的部位吧——但要小心，它们掉落的任何东西都可能会被其他敌人捡起来继续战斗。
掠夺，射杀，再来一次
每次任务都会给予新的模组，供你装入升级网格中。随心混合，自由搭配，任意叠加。只要格子放得下，怎么升级都可以。一点一点将粗拼烂凑的机器人和粗制滥造的武器进化成精密调校好的死亡机器（当然也可能是糟糕的工程学失误啦，都是你说了算）。你可以专攻奶妈辅助，在链锯上安个偏导护盾，或者干脆把自己变成一颗炸弹（我们才不管呢）。
蟑螂休息站
在任务间隙，回到你那装满玩具和小游戏的轨道运输舰中休息。与朋友一起闲逛，探索更多银河系的秘密，或者找赛克森公司的昆虫老兵螂查德·考克斯闲聊几句，打发时间。

critic.quote: Mycopunk is a fast, chaotic FPS game with a goofy premise, fun gameplay, and plenty to upgrade and customize. The game’s aesthetic may not be for everyone, but when the rubber meets the road, Mycopunk is a hoot with friends. If you’re looking for something new to play with your friend group, it’s an excellent option.

Mycopunk blends co-op shooting, unbridled mobility, and surprisingly deep customization, along with several brilliant ideas. While there is a bit too much repetition, the progression can occasionally feel slow, and the visual clarity isn’t always perfect, it’s a great package for the price if you’re a fan of co-op shooters.

Whether Mycopunk can keep its good favour for the true endgame remains to be seen, but getting there is a fun, though slightly arduous, ride. The small, often humorous touches to the mechanics of an established first person shooter genre are definitely welcome, and I'm sure many will be delighted to hear that I wasn't asked for real-world currency once. It's hard to consider anything a sure-fire h

As an early game Mycopunk has a lot of time and opportunity to add more to its arsenal. Once there’s more base content and more to do overall, it’ll be well worth diving into, but for less than £15 it’s not a bad shout to support a dev who clearly has a lot of passion for the genre. [Early Access Review]

Mycopunk has a lot to offer; it’s full of character, its gunplay is fun, and it has a promising future of further support and development ahead of it. However, some of its key features, including the visuals, the grindy playstyle, and slow progression, are easily polarizing; these are systems you’re either going to love, hate, or physically can’t appreciate, in the case of the rare player I’m sure

Mycopunk shows a ton of promise, but that doesn't mean it's infallible. The progression can become a bit of a slog, and it can take a while to level up or collect enough resources to upgrade your kit. There's also definitely a cap as to how many missions you can do in a row before it all just blends into a violent blur. The variety in mission types only keeps things fresh for so long. critic.quote: Nice to see another Assassin’s Creed game to explain yet another exciting story on another character, well done Ubisoft.

Assassin's Creed Mirage is an excellent homage to the past and a well-realized title in its own merits. Evoking elements that made the franchise a huge success and marrying them with several of the improvements made in recent games, it is a great game and it has a beautiful approach to telling the story of one of the most intriguing characters in the franchise: Basim.

Mirage is more of a tribute that a return to the classics, but the setting, the level design and the reasonable length are welcome changes to make Assassin’s Creed more enjoyable for the fans of the first games.

If you're a long-time Assassin's Creed fan that fondly remembers the early entries of the series, you're likely to love Assassin's Creed Mirage. Those who have found the last trio of entries simply too big will appreciate its sharper focus, too. While it does little to propel the series forward mechanically, it's a return to what made it stand out in the first place: an open world stealth game whe

Assassin's Creed Mirage recalls the chapters of the "pre role-playing" era with a certain effectiveness, with a system of notoriety that pushes you to return to anonymity with the means at Basim's disposal. Between the pleasant exploration of Baghdad - well characterized and equipped with the right amount of secondary activities - and interesting main missions, at least as regards level design and

Assassin's Creed Mirage sets off in search of its roots, and it finds them — both for better and worse. Undeniably basic in its approach to stealth and combat, it feels oddly dated in terms of design, but it's also a refreshing reminder of the series' original strengths. Ultimately, it's a solid sandbox title, and it successfully scratches the hidden blade itch that was so clearly absent in Odysse

critic.quote: NBA 2K26 stands as the best entry in the series to date. Visual Concepts has further refined the gameplay, delivering greater realism and a more balanced reward system for the benefit of players. The WNBA plays a larger role in this installment, with expanded integration of both women’s and men’s basketball. MyTEAM feels more exciting than ever, while the new ProPLAY Motion Engine and rhythmic sho

NBA 2K26 is a release that stands out from previous editions and is definitely the basketball game the current generation has been needing for a long time. There's still plenty of room for improvement, but the work and development demonstrated this year confirms that there are solid foundations that, with some commitment, will result in better experiences for fans.

NBA 2K26 is the best installment in the series to date, and is probably the most comprehensive sports game on the market. It offers countless game modes, all powered by the revamped ProPLAY engine, which breathes new life into the gameplay and realism offered by the game. A must-have for all NBA fans who want to play with both current and past rosters, as well as the entire WNBA, which is coming t

NBA 2K26 continues to successfully live up to its reputation as “the best basketball game.” Yes, it may not introduce groundbreaking new features or modes, but it manages to take last year's good and make it even better.

NBA 2K26 hits the ground running as a complete and solid game in every respect, featuring a technical department up to the task, the series’ classic gameplay further refined and free of major flaws, and a substantial number of modes designed to keep you engaged with new content available at the start of each season, all the way until the next installment in the franchise.

NBA 2K26 is the best the series has offered in recent years in terms of gameplay and online content, and it’s a good starting point for anyone new who doesn’t mind the abundance of microtransactions and the slow progression.

s.desc:

率领您的部队，为胜利而战吧！
独特小队机制
玩家将指挥自己的小队投入战斗，除玩家直接操控的士兵外，小队内其他单位均由 AI 控制。即使出现伤亡，玩家也能立即切换至小队内其他士兵继续战斗。
独特的小队玩法让从军能够营造真正的大战场氛围，忠实还原了第二次世界大战一线战斗的烈度与强度！
真实战场环境
身临其境体验战火世界中多条战线上的历史战斗：从炮火连天的太平洋岛屿，到诺曼底登陆后肃清村庄；从柏林街头帝国最后的困兽犹斗，到保卫莫斯科最危急的时刻；从热战正酣的斯大林格勒到突尼斯的漫天黄沙……
第二次世界大战主要参战国中有 4 个国家在游戏内登场：美国、苏联、德国与日本。玩家可以选择加入任何一个国家，组建技能多样、职阶专长各异的小队为胜利而战。游戏根据战斗的真实交战方分配交战国家，不同国家的参战部队装备有阵营专属的武器载具，士兵外观也做到了真实还原。
多兵种联合作战
在步兵装备之外，《从军》还囊括了坦克、装甲车、摩托车等一系列地面载具，还包括战斗机与轰炸机的空中力量。多达 400款载具涵盖了绝大多数玩家耳熟能详的二战装备，驾驭这些钢铁巨兽迈向胜利吧！
此外，坦克手与机组成员不仅能够操纵技术兵器，也是受过战斗训练的优质战士——载具严重损毁、除了弃车逃生难道别无他法了吗？乘员组还可以拿起武器与步兵一起战斗，他们的战斗力也不容小觑！

critic.quote: Overwatch 2 plays brilliantly. It’s a wonderful shooter full of depth, with unique heroes to master, maps to learn, and hours of your life to lose all over again.

Overwatch 2 is a worthy successor to the original Overwatch that doesn’t so much reinvent the wheel as it does improve upon it. While it does have its issues, the core gameplay and improved UI make for a fun and fully realized sequel.

Overwatch 2 simply exists in an awkward transition phase between the game it was and the game it wants to be. It's not a revolution by any stretch, at least not how the original game was, but it's still Overwatch and that means it's still a ton of fun.

It’s difficult to look back on a game like Overwatch and wonder what it could’ve been if it had been delayed, and released as a complete, full-priced package with none of the extras: no feel-bad Battle Passes, with the story mode and Hero Missions available to all from the get-go. It’s not all doom and gloom of course; I’ve been in denial about the change in direction for PvP, but tens of hours of

This is, really, a relaunch dressed up as a sequel, although the game remains as fun as ever. Some balancing issues and, of course, a questionable progression system hinder the potential of Overwatch 2.
Overwatch 2 is as fun and fast-paced as the original game, but its free-to-play structure sullies the experience a bit.

critic.quote: With all around fantastic gameplay, graphics, design, and just overall fun, I’d argue that under different circumstances, this could have even been considered a game of the year contender. I never realized just how much the Sony PlayStation had influenced my life until I played this game.

This is a huge surprise. A “free game” that’s actually better than many of those you have to pay for - and also the best showcase of the capabilities of the DualSense controller which has the potential to change how we experience video games.
Astro’s Playroom is a creative surprise. For the PS5 launch Asobi Team serves up a jump-and-run highlight – preinstalled!

As well as being an excellent demonstration of the future ahead for owners of the PS5, Astro’s Playroom serves as an excellent, albeit brief platformer. You’ll find that just as the game really begins to come into its own, it ends, and that’s an almighty shame, but will likely you leaving salivating at the prospect of what is to come for Astro Bot and friends.
Astro's Playroom is just that; a playroom for the next generation - a small glimpse into what the PlayStation 5 will be able to do with the DualSense.

Astro's Playroom, a game that makes no attempt to hide the fact that it is an excuse to show you what a gamepad can do, conjures a world that you will want to see and explore. More than that, its surprisingly delightful celebration of PlayStation and its video games is a great way to kick off a console generation.

Apex Legends is one of the more entertaining, beautifully balanced, and gorgeous games in the Battle Royale genre. The fact that it is free is delightful, and a good move by Respawn Entertainment. Apex Legends is a mix of smart shooter ideas that makes for a competitive, team-based game that gets at all the best parts of battle royale while addressing a lot of the weaknesses. Respawn's intense focus on team play makes Apex more than just a worthy addition to the genre; it's an indicator of where battle royale should go in the future.

critic.quote: Fall Guys is an extremely addictive and accessible fun for the entire family. It is hilarious even when you are losing terribly, which makes it the biggest hit of the summer and possibly also the winter ahead of us. [Issue#306]
A breath of fresh, bright and breezy air after a summer of hard-hitting AAA’s, Fall Guys cements itself as an essential addition to your party library. Believe the hype.

Fall Guys balances frustration and enjoyment perfectly, handing you victory at the expense of someone else whilst snatching it away from you just as much. Despite some irritating, luck-based team games, Fall Guys is a one of a kind experience that will only get better season to season. It's the most fun I've had with a game in years.

If Fall Guys can keep up its current momentum with a steady stream of skins and minigames, I see no reason why it can’t be one of the top contenders in the battle royale genre. It’s got the charm, the fun gameplay, and the multiplayer communituy focus that’s as fun to watch as it is to play, and these beans don’t seem to be slowing down anytime soon.
Full of cute and cuddly jellybean dude bumbling into each other in a race for the crown, Fall Guys is just about the most wholesome battle royale imaginable, and a whole lot of fun.
Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout is a game that bets on simplicity and entertainment, with very good sensations and awaiting tweaks that enhance it even more.

critic.quote: Even without a museum to sate that historian interest, Capcom Arcade Stadium is a fantastic compilation. The game list has a nice mix of familiar classics and hidden gems, with the usual quality of life touches, rotating special challenges to keep things fresh, and charming, nostalgic presentation. It’s also the collection that finally brought the bullet hell masterpiece Progear to console, and th

While I did miss the classic cabinets in each title, there are still plenty of frames and other display options to choose from. Next to an actual arcade, Capcom Arcade Library will give you the retro gameplay you’re looking for and may even save you a few quarters along the way.

All in all the Capcom Arcade Stadium is a lovely little package. Whether you are an old-timer like me who reminisces over their mis-spent youth, or someone who would like to explore the earlier days of gaming, Capcom’s legacy as a maker of fine arcade games is here for all to see.

Overall, Capcom Arcade Stadium is a very good package filled with brilliant games, each updated with modern functionality. It doesn’t rival the quality of original hardware or the likes of M2’s sublime individual ports of arcade masterworks as seen with the release of Esp.Ra.De Psi, but at £30 for 32 games, it is well worth the price, warts and all.
Capcom Arcade Stadium provides a generous bunch of golden-age arcade titles (with a little too much Street-Fighterism), paired with a vast assortment of options and gorgeous presentation.

Capcom Arcade Stadium is an essential purchase for fans of retro gaming. Loaded with a ton of content, this game will keep newcomers and returning gamers entertained for hours. Although there are a few titles and features missing, this collection is still a fantastic addition to your Nintendo Switch library.

critic.quote: It's undeniable to say that Marvel Rivals beat every odd stacked against it, and that's purely based on merit alone. It's a fun team-based shooter with new and old ideas featured prominently throughout its 33-character roster that kept me wanting for more.

Marvel Rivals is a rare example of a live service launch done right. Some aspects might feel more derivative, but the promise of future content that'll build on what's already a solid foundation is proof that Marvel Rivals is here to stay.

Even if you have never cared for hero shooters, I urge you to give this one a try. It's free-to-play, and if you have any love for superhero properties you'll find a character you love among this motley bunch. It is certainly inspired by games that came before, but its fast, frenetic pace and secret strategic weight make it something completely different. Like a sidekick growing into his mentor's

One free game leads to another, Marvel heroes and villains are welcome if the goal is simply to have fun. Between questionable balance and general lack of originality, some will turn up their noses, but how fun is Marvel Rivals.

Marvel Rivals takes on the bold challenge of building upon the foundation laid by Overwatch and adding its own unique spin--and it largely succeeds. With solid overall quality, accessible mechanics, and a wealth of content, the game feels primed for long-term success and has already captured the attention of a massive audience. Its enduring popularity is a testament to its strong design and engagi
Marvel Rivals is not a perfect game, it does not bring novelty and innovation to the playing field. It's just a clever use of branding, and it's fun to play as your favourite characters.

critic.quote: Dead or Alive 6 is amazing. It’s the best looking fighting game out there, bar none, and has a combat system that is both instantly accessible for newcomers, without feeling condescending, and yet also offering plenty of depth and complexity for experienced fans. It’s not perfect; the story mode is enjoyable but slightly undercooked, and one suspects that we’ll have to wait until pretty deep into

Dead or Alive 6 is a mechanically solid and foundationally sound fighting game. At its core, playing matches with others is a fun and thrilling experience that’s easy to grasp if you’re new to fighters or the series. Its lack of modes, however, coupled with its small roster, and a recently revealed $92 season pass raise a lot of questions as to what ideals drove the game’s development. For those l

Dead Or Alive 6 is still a very good fighting game which allows instant fun, even for a novice player, but you'll need serious skills to defeat a seasoned player. We only regret long, loading times and a weird storyline.

Dead or Alive 6 serves up great fighting mechanics, solid offline mode variety, and looks good while doing it. If you're a fan of the series, it's well worth checking out, even as this latest entry stumbles in the online arenas and the disappointing approach to customization.

Ultimately, I’m not sure if Dead or Alive 6 is the game that fans expected after a seven-year wait, but with its thrilling combat and amazing visuals, it still serves up a fulfilling experience — fanservice and all.

Dead or Alive 6 has a lot going for it – solid combat mechanics and an incredible tutorial mode being the elements that stands out the most – but overall it feels a little too bland and lacking in content to stand out in the sea of great fighting games of yesteryear.

Speedstorm has truly conveyed the Disney-Pixar essence into a videogame. Good first season, even though the progress in game and the rewards system lack that Disney magic.

Disney Speedstorm, even in its early access form, is shaping up to be a great kart racer that can shape up to other top-tier titles within the genre. With plenty of challenges, racers, and modes to try out and unlock, completionists out there have a multitude of reasons to hop into the game again and again while burning rubber as your favourite Disney or Pixar character. While the sheer amount of

Disney Speedstorm is certainly “on a roll” with its electrifying stages and game design, but it’s certainly not “undefeated.” The confusing microtransactions pull it down and become an annoying distraction to what’s great in this kart racer. While a love for the Disney product is certainly present in Disney Speedstorm, there are a few annoying aspects of the game to be mindful of.

Overall, Disney Speedstorm is a good kart racer. The overly complex in-game economy and lack of Grand Prix or other modes outside of single races may push some gamers away, and I wouldn’t blame them. critic.quote: World of Tanks: HEAT is a bold reinvention of a franchise that many players probably didn't expect to see move in this direction. Turning World of Tanks into a hero shooter could have easily felt forced, but Wargaming has managed to create something that feels surprisingly natural once you're actually in a match.

World of Tanks: HEAT from developer Wargaming Group Limited is a good F2P game that offers fun modes, good customization, and a short stint of good MP matches. While the vanilla version of this game isn’t quite packed with a huge variety of modes, it still is a good way to have some dumb fun.

World of Tanks: HEAT successfully reimagines Wargaming’s classic tank warfare as a faster, more accessible tactical vehicle shooter. Its Agents, abilities and objective-based modes give the formula a welcome hero-shooter edge, although its long-term appeal will depend on balance, progression and post-launch support.

World of Tanks: Heat is a solid entry in the WoT franchise. The free-to-play model with premium paid options is a great way to bring new players into the fold and won’t risk pricing people out by costing an arm and a leg just to get started. With lots of agents and tanks to unlock and upgrade, World of Tanks: Heat is a well that will not run dry any time soon.
World of Tanks: Heat has potential rooted in fast-paced, visually impressive battles. However, right now it feels more like an open beta missing crucial and inexplicably omitted features.

World of Tanks: Heat stands out as a stylish tank shooter featuring hero classes that add depth and variety. However, the team-based gameplay across the various modes constantly oscillates between slow and tactical pursuit and fast-paced action, without ever fully committing to either.

critic.quote: Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium's more eclectic offering is excellent. With a familiar presentation, array of extras, and wealth of options; it's a fitting follow-up to last year's incredible collection of arcade treasures so if you enjoyed that then definitely play this, too.
Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium might not be as essential as its predecessor, and you might wonder why these games couldn’t have just been delivered as DLC, but it’s still a fantastic retro collection.

Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium shouldn’t have much difficulty finding an audience. For folks like me who grew up in the arcades, there are plenty of nostalgic hits here that will motivate a purchase. Thankfully, gamers can purchase titles individually or as a full collection. It might be hard to justify buying the whole collection if you already own Capcom Fighting Collection. This was poor planning on
The emulation is perfect and it has many display options and unlockables. Its value, of course, depends on how nostalgic we are.
Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium once again delivers the experience of visiting an arcade with tons of great titles; this collection is sure to be a good time.

For those who merely dabble in arcade classics, then the way to go may be to hand-pick the games you want to play and checkout with a cheaper cart in hand. There are some real highlights in this collection that would be a shame to miss out on for a gamer of any flavor.

critic.quote: If you enjoy pinball in any shape or form, Zen Pinball 2 is a must download.
From Soho down to Brighton, it's the best videogame version of pinball you'll find.

Zen Pinball 2 is the game for the more casual fan, but pinball enthusiasts will also have a great time, despite the physics not quite being 100% realistic. The buttery smooth 60fps in 1080p also does wonders for the experience and this is the best version of a Zen made pinball game yet.

The great pinball simulator we already know arrives on PS4 letting us download all the tables we've already purchased on PS3 and PS Vita versions. There's no new additions, but the experience is as good and addictive as it is on other platforms.
As it stands, the game is a fun romp, but only if you can get past the differences from real pinball psychologically.

After its enjoyable outings on previous platforms, Zen Pinball 2 has arrived on the PS4 in good form. Assuming that you can get past the inflexible purchasing options and cut through the sometimes overwhelming digital gloss, you’ll find a flipping fun game with an addictive core at its steel-coated centre.

你的极限由想象力决定。

critic.quote: The Finals has given me some of my favorite multiplayer moments in 2023. Whether actively engaging in vertical combat or excitedly scaling rooftops on the way to the next objective, navigating the environments feels incredible, and the thrill of watching the ground disappear from below my feet never gets old. In a year of groundbreaking video game releases, The Finals is yet another highlight.

The Finals is the kind of game that you play when you want to live an action film. You’ll most definitely find a playstyle you like in one or more of the three classes. While there are too many factors outside of player control to consider this a truly high-level competitive game, it sure is a fun time. That being said, if you’ve been disappointed by recent FPS titles, then try The Finals for some

Hellishly fun multiplayer action, standing on a well-executed class system and the destruction of everything around. It excels in both aspects. Whether you're running on walls to send enemies back to respawn with an automatic shotgun or breaking through the floor to send a guarded safe to another floor, these are some of the best gaming moments you can experience with friends. It's just a shame th
Bombastic fun: The Finals cannot be categorized as an online shooter. And that is really refreshing.

The Finals offers an easy-to-learn FPS playground with a strong visual identity and some of the best destruction tech I’ve ever seen. Time will tell whether it can keep an audience, but right now it’s slick.
With loadouts to assemble and coordinated teams laughing to the bank, every breath of The Finals’ destruction does justice to its game show ambitions.

critic.quote: Warframe brings a new and addicting experience to the PlayStation franchise. Along with great and fluid combat, this is a free-to-play title that will justify microtransactions in a positive way.

The core gameplay, including the variety of suits and weapons, is terrific, and it’s reason enough to play this sci-fi shooter. But the boring story, too-similar missions, and aggressive payment model hold it back from what it could be.
If you can live with the pervading sense of confusion, there’s a lot of game here for no money. Whether it convinces you to part with some cash or not, you’ll still keep coming back.
Warframe, which has been out for PC since March, is free-to-play on the PS4, and in spite of its bugs, is worth the no-cost price.

The freedom of movement and cooperative combos make Warframe an entertaining coop game. Unfortunately, that only really counts if you're willing to spend money on it. Warframe is not only very misleading, but would improve from the extra content. The restrictive free-to-play model isn't working in Warframe's favor.
It's free, it's fine, and it's instantly forgettable. [Issue#143, p.104]

critic.quote: Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra does not reinvent the wheel. Instead, incorporates all the engaging elements of other MOBAs on the market and delivers a highly entertaining experience with substantial challenge. It is not League of Legends with skins of Akira Toriyama's characters. It is a video game that provides all the necessary elements to offer enjoyable matches for every fan of this franchise.

Dragon Ball Genkishin Squadra, from developer Ganbarion and Bandai Namco Games, is a surprisingly solid MOBA game. It takes the Dragon Ball universe and merges it beautifully within the MOBA genre without losing the essence of the IP.

Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra is Bandai Namco’s answer to the stagnation of the MOBA genre, a title that forgoes the extreme complexity typical of League of Legends and Dota 2 in favor of a more immediate, dynamic, and accessible approach.

DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA is one of my new favourite online multiplayer games thanks to its incredibly fun and frantic large-scale battles that keep you strategising and forging ahead while taking in the awesome sights and sounds which will make any fan light up.

Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra turns a complex genre like the MOBA into an accessible and entertaining experience without losing depth in the process, while also paying tribute to Akira Toriyama’s work. Although it features a limited starting roster, few game modes, and monetization that restricts access to key content, this may very well be one of the series’ best purely online games.

Dragon Ball: Gekishin Squadra is a bold move for the franchise, venturing into the MOBA genre with a result that works and is fun to play, but still needs a bit more refinement to reach its full potential. Improving character balance, refining the interface and adding more interaction with the environments. Still, fans of the series are going to enjoy it.

Infinity Nikki doesn’t reinvent any wheels, push boundaries, or

critic.quote: With stellar storytelling and satisfying progression that offer dozens of hours of content that newcomers and hardcore players can enjoy, Honkai: Star Rail is a free-to-play RPG that might hook you for months – without making you feel like you have to pay.

It's hard not to fall for the charms of Honkai: Star Rail. The storyline, even if it draws on Japanese anime clichés, is extremely rich, populated by sparkling characters and written with a great deal of humor. Honkai Star Rail is a highly polished turn-based RPG that builds off the Hoyoverse gacha machine, and while it certainly doesn’t reinvent the wheel, its colourful cast of characters and mercurial tone sets it on the right track.
A great role playing game with turn based combat, free and fun. It does not reach the quality of Genshin Impact but it is close.

s.desc:
人类入侵了一艘巨大的星际飞船，几乎将一种古老的蛛形生物灭绝殆尽。但一只幼蛛幸存了下来……
如今，你成为了族群最后的希望。
探索这艘巨型飞船的废弃区域，猎杀太空昆虫和入侵者，吞噬猎物，从弱小的生物进化成致命的掠食者。
每个关卡都会带你前往飞船的新区域，那里有独特的环境、生物群落、陷阱和敌人。利用周围环境生存下去，不断变强，并解锁新的能力。
游戏特色：
- 扮演一种独特的外星蛛形生物。
- 以太空生物为食，不断成长进化。
- 探索一艘充满各种生物群落的庞大废弃星际飞船。
- 体验快节奏的2D横版动作游戏，并不断进化。
- 与灭绝你族群的敌人战斗，夺回你的家园。

众所周知，《字母B的受难日》是一款非常“简单”的可爱游戏：
* 本游戏不会让你摔键盘。
* 本游戏不会让你怀疑人生。
* 本游戏不会让你破防！
如果发生了以上情况……那只能说明你玩得太认真了（真的）。
在这个精美的手绘画风世界里，你可以随时在26个不同的字母之间瞬时切换，利用每个字母的独特形状来越过障碍。
没错，简单跳一跳就能过关啦！
我们为每个字母都赋予了独特的能力：
* 变身 J 或 V？可以跳得更高——不过玩家都说，你根本不用管跳的高不高，随便跳就行。
* 变成 L 或 T？那是为了勾住边缘——不过大家一致反馈，根本没掉下去过。
* 变作 O 或 C？能滚能钻——不过滚到哪儿都一样，因为障碍只是背景啦。
* 至于 X、H？用来平衡和挡墙？别闹了，这可是治愈系游戏，哪会有墙朝你撞过来呢？（目移）
没错，这就是一款休闲治愈的看风景游戏！（确信）

《碎片守望：统治》是一款经典的俯视角塔防游戏，场景设定在圆形竞技场中。你需要保护中央堡垒及其闪耀的水晶，抵御来自四面八方的敌人进攻。
每一个决定都至关重要：建造位置、水晶的用途以及每波敌人之间的升级。布局和资源管理决定着堡垒能否守住阵地。
建造。升级。防御。
主要特色：
- 360度圆形塔防地图
- 水晶矿工和资源管理
- 弓箭手、城墙、尖刺、树根、火焰、闪电等等
- 每波敌人之间永久升级
- 防御塔数量限制和战略布局
- 草地、沙漠和荒地环境
- 波次式敌人进攻
- 可爱的手绘卡通风格

《PAPERHEAD》包含快节奏移动、轰炸枪击以及恐怖剧情，并辅以独特的配乐。
纸板世界可爱迷人，可怕危机悄然降临。
探索废弃研究设施，揭开黑暗的真相
……纸板人为什么会……流血？
雷厉风行的残酷激战
抛掷敌人，瞄准它们踢出火药桶，然后像某个意大利水管工一样迎头跳下！
或者简单点，直接用霰弹枪轰碎它们！
画出道路，逃离[已删除]
铅笔——是武器，也是改变周遭世界的工具。
画出炸弹，踢向敌人！
画出门板，一脚踢翻！
在墙上书写 ██████ 字句——干就完了！
可爱……但也可怕
可爱迷人的纸板世界……比想象中更加有血有肉。纸片也能让人毛骨悚然！
纸片有时比金属更坚韧
工业风配乐，营造一触即发的激情。
大步向前，探明真相……
纸板人为什么会……流血？
P.S. 小心！游戏时不要割伤手指 :-)

Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest是一款沉浸式动作冒险游戏，背景设定在备受喜爱的《猫武士》系列小说中的蛮荒野地。你将踏上各种各样的任务，以赢取族群的青睐，并在回合制战斗中与其他族群较量，以此强化你的猫、铸就你的传奇。学习新的战斗招式来击败对手。遭遇丰富多样的敌人，包括老鼠、松鼠、獾等，最终还将迎来史诗级战斗。在土地上搜寻，找到可用于在巢穴中制作物品的材料。穿越标志性的领地，包括雷族茂密的森林、河族的沼泽地、影族阴暗的松树湿地，以及风族开阔的荒原。你的冒险还将带你前往著名的神圣地点——月亮池和岛屿。攀爬树木、跃过灌木丛、追踪气味、破解环境谜题，并揭开星族自身的秘密。

s.desc:
《PEAK》是一款需要细致合作的登山游戏，作为流落神秘岛屿的童子军探险家，无论单人独闯抑或团队协力，你们唯一获救的希望便是登上岛中那座巍峨的山峰，自然荒野险途漫漫，稍有不慎便会大难临头。顶峰在望，你有魄力能征服它吗？
"团队协作
需要搭把手吗？和萍水相逢的朋友患难与共，无论是帮忙登上岩架，抑或是放置绳索岩钉为后来人开路，要想登上日日变换的高山，朋友们的援手是你唯一的依靠。"
"攀登
大山不讲慈悲！4 种独特的生态地貌横亘在你们前往顶峰的途中，各自有着各自的危险要命套路。寻找一切可疑的食物以求果腹，小心照料身上的伤口——任何不利因素都会限制体能，令你的攀登之途更加险阻。"
"生存
只做最坏打算：探索多种实用生存道具，能量饮料助你恢复体力，攀岩钢钉助你突破险境，更有神秘的反重绳索等你深挖妙用。唯有善用每一项优势，才能有望征服顶峰。"
"每天岛屿不重样
游戏地图每 24 小时轮换一次！每天都能体验新的场景布局，或者在一天内盯死同个岛屿重复挑战，直至挑战成功。"
"赢取奖章
争当老练童军：赢取酷炫外观，用各色奖章向大家证明你才是真正的生存专家！"
"与友共攀乐趣多
《PEAK》的多人模式仅限好友协力——邀请至多 3 名在线好友一起共攀高峰吧，若是真的够胆，独闯山巅自然未尝不可！"
本作特色
在线——跨平台合作；离线——做独狼勇闯
4 名好友共同攀登
近距聊天保持交流
形形色色生态地图等待探索
各种可疑果腹食物
多种独特登山道具
围着营火烤棉花糖
可自定义个性角色
死了还能变成鬼魂

s.desc:
经典的萌系射击原版游戏经过重制强化后现已回归。你将在《棉花小魔女：重启》中度过真正的魔幻时光！
原版棉花小魔女
《棉花小魔女：重启》欢迎你！这款精彩的系列游戏于1991年在街机中首次现身，两年后被移植到日本传奇家用电脑Sharp X68000平台上。这是我们第一次遇见保护仙境的小魔女Cotton和妖精Silk。从那时开始，这些角色已经成为整个萌系射击游戏品类中最耀眼夺目的吉祥物。现在，这款神奇游戏经过重制强化后正式回归！
四倍乐趣
《棉花小魔女：重启》共有四种不同的游戏方式！首先也是最重要的是，全新改编模式(Arrange Mode)采用宽屏高清格式，加入了高清图形和全新的声优配音。 你也可以使用紧张的限时模式，你的时间会严格限制在2或5分钟内；或者你也可以享受游戏原版X68000的格式，看看过去几十年里游戏发生了哪些变化。最后但同样重要的一点是，新添加的噩梦模式提高了游戏难度和增加了几个新敌人。（噩梦模式仅在本游戏2026版中提供。）
扫帚杆摇摆
《棉花小魔女：重启》推出了一个可选的重新制作的原声，由日本游戏历史上一些真实巨星创作。包括Shinji Hosoe (Tekken, Ridge Racer)、Hiroyuki Kawada (Time Crisis, Super Smash Bros.)和Hisayoshi Ogura (Darius)。不论你选择新版音乐还是原版原声，在你骑着飞天扫帚杆扫射敌人时，爽快感觉绝对倍增！
珠宝狂热
《棉花小魔女：重启》中一项最重要的游戏机制是所谓的“珠宝狂热”。在你扫射敌人时，进度条会被充满。充满后，你就激活了这个模式，可以显著提升你的火力。在“珠宝狂热”模式下，击败敌人赢得的点数也会增加。你可以用它通关困难场景并获得更多分散。不管你是否使用这个新机制，你都肯定会度过一段真正的魔幻时光。
使用水晶！
《棉花小魔女：重启》是一款精美的横轴滚动的梦想射击游戏。你使用一个按键射击，用另一个按键向地面敌人投掷炸弹。被击中的敌人会掉落出黄色水晶，可以用来提升你的主要武器火力。但是，如果你射中水晶，它们会变色，给予你不同的元素法术。怎么玩全由你决定！

For light shmups that players of any skill can beat (SO MUCH more forgiving than R-Type Final 2), but with two different sets of mechanics that will give skilled players something to master, Cotton Reboot is a great game with a lot of fun to offer.
Content aside –as it needs a bit more, in our opinion–, Cotton Reboot is a fantastic shoot ‘em up for those looking for a nostalgic trip.
Cotton Reboot does a fantastic job of bringing Cotton and cute 'em ups to a new generation of players with its excellent gameplay, gorgeous visuals, and great soundtrack.

It looks and sounds better than ever and thanks to being able to switch between soundtracks, players can enjoy whichever audio experience they prefer. s.desc:
柳树糖果在反叛！帮助小魔女Cotton打败这些邪恶的糖果！
重启的后续
《棉花小魔女：重启！高张力！》是《彩虹棉花小魔女》系列的最新款游戏。这款经典的萌系射击游戏于1991年第一次在日本街机平台发行。现在，你可操控小魔女Cotton与她忠实（？！）的妖精伙伴Silk一起探险。原版游戏的现代重制版是《棉花小魔女：重启！》，而《棉花小魔女：重启！高张力！》则是该重制版的后续演化版。魔幻！
横空出世的动作体验大作
有两种不同的射击方式：或者纵向滚动或者横向滚动。《棉花小魔女：重启！高张力！》是后者范例。你可操控小魔女Cotton骑着扫帚，前向射击或使用炸弹攻击地面目标。你将面对无数敌人带来的艰巨挑战，但是Cotton的火力无以匹敌。向前进攻，你将所向披靡。
水晶法力
你在《棉花小魔女：重启！高张力！》中击败敌人时，他们会掉落黄色水晶。如果你在捡起水晶前击中它们，它们就会变色。变色的水晶可帮助你升级不同的元素法术。但是还有更多内容！不断射中水晶和消灭更多敌人，你将填满一个特别进度条，最终激活“柳树狂热”模式。
《棉花小魔女：高张力！》
你想知道“高张力”续集怎样出现吗？好吧，这与游戏的著名机制相关联！在你进入“柳树狂热”模式后，收集柳树糖果，就可进入“高张力”。“高张力”激活以后，敌人的攻击就变得异常凶猛，但是回报则是你使用隐藏的强大法术迅速提升你的分数。如果你想要获得更高得分，就有必要学习如何正确使用“高张力”的技巧。祝你好运！

Playground VR 这是一款VR物理沙盒游戏，汇集了各类载具、武器、运动项目以及各种可供探索的玩法。探索城市、与AI车手竞速、挑战跑酷赛道——或者钻进大炮里，化身一枚弹丸。
挑战新纪录，制作些奇奇怪怪的东西，或者花一个下午的时间，看看按下那个按钮会发生什么。
- 探索这座城市。爬上屋顶，体验滑索，去办公室和健身房逛逛，或者在摩天轮上欣赏美景。下楼的过程本身也可能是一场冒险。
- 坐上驾驶座——或者腾空而起。在城里兜风，开着摩托艇驶向水面，乘坐热气球翱翔，或者穿上喷气背包。前往日落赛道，与AI对手一决高下。
- 打造属于你的装置。在工作坊中将木板、车轮、火箭和开关连接起来。制作一辆能正常运行的车辆，然后看看再加一个火箭会发生什么。
- 试用各种武器。拿起手枪、步枪、霰弹枪、火箭发射器、激光武器、剑和弓箭。尝试运用物理原理，将布娃娃角色撞来撞去，并放慢时间来观察效果。
- 测试你的射击准头。在射击场挑战静止目标、移动目标以及射箭项目。你可以选择无限弹药，也可以在每次射击后手动装弹。
- 挑战限时关卡。在设有移动平台和旋转障碍物的限时跑酷赛道上攀爬、跳跃并保持平衡。再次挑战，争取跑得更快。
- 玩几局吧。投篮、踢足球、收集金币，或者挑战摩托艇项目。如果你更想制造点动静，这里还有一架钢琴。
- 寻找惊喜。发现隐藏的笑点和彩蛋，解锁成就并赚取积分，用于参与更多游乐场活动。
你来这里是为了试用那门大炮。下午剩下的时间怎么安排，就看你自己了。

书房里躺着一具尸体。五个人，每个人都有不可告人的秘密。
著名发明家克里斯托弗·爱德华在自己家中惨遭杀害。你将扮演侦探卡拉·罗宾斯，接手这起案件。你要询问他的妻子、秘书、管家、女佣和家庭医生。每个人都礼貌地微笑，却对当晚发生的事各执一词。究竟谁在撒谎？
仔细聆听，比对证词，找出矛盾。把每一项证据记录在互动式案件档案中，一点点拼凑出真相。有时，关键线索就藏在你初次调查时忽略的细节里。
动机是爱情、金钱，还是权力？牵动关键的线索，让凶手无处可逃。
• 融合侦探冒险与隐藏物品玩法的现代游戏
• 审问嫌疑人，整合线索与证据
• 富有氛围感的配乐与扣人心弦的犯罪故事
• 互动式案件档案，记录你收集的所有证据

噬咬、掠夺、逆袭！
《愚者不灭（Stupid Never Dies）》是一款疾速成长系 3D 动作角色扮演游戏。在怪物盘踞的地下异世界中，战五渣小僵尸将以不可思议的速度变得强大无比。
你将扮演潜居怪物社会底层的僵尸戴维，勇闯危机四伏的地下世界，一路吞噬敌人、夺取力量、改造肉身，展开一场不可思议的大冒险。
■ 最弱僵尸爱上葬身冰窟的人类女子。
世界满目疮痍，怪物主宰一切，而人类则在灭绝的边缘苟延残喘。
身为超级孬种僵尸的戴维，偶然在冷库中发现了被冻成冰块的女孩——朱莉娅，并对她一见钟情。
为了解冻“冰棍甜心”，戴维必须一路杀入地下世界最深处，吞噬 KOM（怪物之王），夺回被窃取的人类文明知识结晶。这只被爱情冲昏头脑的废柴僵尸，究竟能否复活朱莉娅，让初恋美梦成真？（顺便……说不定还能拯救世界？！）
■ 别具一格的僵尸动作体验
▼ 异噬
大口啃食精英怪物的核心，获取全新力量。
操纵狼人、吸血鬼、鹰身人等 11 种各具特色的异变，把敌人揍个落花流水。
▼ 身体改造
使用升级后的装备强化各个身体部位。
不同装备组合将彻底改变你的能力与战斗策略。
▼ 戴维爆发
使用特殊能力让现实靠边，尽情发挥疯狂想象。
大幅增强各项属性，在战斗中实现惊天逆转。
■ 狂野的怪物
在超限科技的加持下，吸血鬼、狼人、鹰身人等传说中的生物踏入全新境界！哪怕是同一种怪物，根据身上的装备不同，战斗方式也会大相径庭。

critic.quote: With boldness and charisma, Stupid Never Dies shows some minor stumbles in pacing - or lack thereof - and in the targeting of attacks in certain circumstances, but nothing that diminishes the graphic quality, the intense combat system, and a plot that knows very well how to rely on the fundamental principles of the genre and the thematic absurdity to bring the lightness that the end of the world d

Stupid Never Dies is an explosive debut for GPTRACK50, successfully blending the progression of an action RPG with the frantic, immediate thrill of an arcade roguelite. Despite some rough edges in combat precision—most notably the lack of a lock-on system and a short-ranged parry—Davy's grotesque, punk-infused crusade remains a wildly entertaining, generous, and addictive ride that keeps evolving

Stupid Never Dies is a game that knows what it wants to be, and that is already a good starting point. The transformation system is its best element: it gives the combat rhythm, encourages experimentation and offers enough variety to make the first hours genuinely enjoyable.

An action RPG with roguelike elements, Stupid Never Dies is mostly stupid in the right ways, with its insane experience multiplier feature and switchable forms standing out. The lack of a lock-on feature in combat can be bothersome, though, and you're too often forced to go back to the game's hub when you're enjoying a run.

So much style, so much soul. Playing Stupid Never Dies, you can feel Davy's heart beating. Both because he's in love with his beautiful frozen human and because the game he stars in is a fun and engaging action roguelite. The combat system is solid and packed with moves, and character progression is a dopamine rush, generously doling out power-ups. However, it has made some controversial choices t
A riotously colourful punk-rock action RPG with clever combat systems and bags of personality, Stupid Never Dies is fun once it clicks, though repetition and awkward targeting frustrate.

s.desc:
《9 Years of Shadows（九年之影）》是由 Halberd Studios 带来的美丽横向卷轴类银河战士恶魔城游戏。
勇敢的女战士欧罗巴（Europa）决定在世界被黑暗吞噬之前，潜入古老的大型机械巨人塔洛斯（Talos）体内，彻底切断黑暗的根源。与因诅咒而变异的怪物战斗、结识众多个性鲜明的音乐家，并揭开夺走世界色彩的诅咒背后的真相吧。
【特色】
横向卷轴动作游戏。在没有能量的状态下受到攻击时会减少 1 点生命值。生命值耗尽则游戏结束。若从游戏结束画面选择继续游戏，将会从上次储存的地点重新开始。
拥抱阿皮诺（Apino）即可补充能量。此外，也能发射光弹来摧毁阻挡去路的黑暗结晶。

critic.quote: If any part of 9 Years of Shadows looks appealing to you, you owe it to yourself to pick it up. This is an amazing game made by a heretofore unknown team, and I can only hope that Halberd Studios has plans for a follow-up. They deserve to be showered in praise, and this game deserves your time and attention.

Nine Years of Shadows is a good Metroidvania with an impressive presentation and intriguing world. Gameplay mechanics will be instantly familiar to any genre fans and easy to understand for newcomers. There aren’t too many surprises in the narrative but it is imbued with a sense of optimism that kept me engaged. I wanted more variety for combat encounters and a smoother difficulty curve for the bo
An enjoyable, entry level metroidvania. It looks, sounds and plays great even if it is a little on the short side.

Hopefully, post-launch patches will arrive to remedy this experience to its best possible iteration because it deserves it. Underneath it all, 9 years of Shadows is a fantastic time assumedly hampered by developmental circumstances.
9 Years of Shadows can be frustrating in places, but if you’re looking for a 2D Metroidvania with solid combat, enjoyable platforming, and beautiful world design, it ticks all of those boxes.

9 Years of Shadows clearly shows that Halberd Studios' underlying ideas are good, but their development hasn't been flawless. Despite a particularly lively background imagery, which mixes different influences in an interesting way, staged with considerable care in the graphics department, this short adventure fails to exploit its full potential.

users.author: gimmesomethruth
users.quote: Although is a short game, what the games offers is a classic experience that reminded me a lot of Aria of Sorrow and Megaman Zero. The music is phenomenal and the backgrounds are breathtaking.

users.author: BarryWhite
users.quote: Short, fun & pretty metroidvania. 9 Years of Shadows is a nice and focused on the basics of a tight Metroidvania which goes great for what they want to show. This is the Lo-fi Metroidvania I didn´t know I wanted.

users.author: Zackblayck
users.quote: This game is a "back to basic" metroidvania but in a totally good way. It feels like a really old game brought to the present. It's vibrant, lively and it's easy to pick up on the game mechanics quickly. The gameplay is smooth, the cutscenes are very well done. The animation is amazing, the way Europa's dress seems to flow is stunning.

s.desc:
Spy on strangers through security cameras, invade their privacy and discover their secrets in this digital voyeur simulator. Welcome to the future of The Primate Observation Club. Even in 2099 the rule about messing with your unlucky subjects still remains in this sequel: DO NOT feed the monkeys!
The Primate Observation Club is still active and stronger than ever in the year 2099. The world has become a hilariously absurd, retro-futuristic dystopia where spying is even more amusing! Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099 is a digital voyeur simulator that combines narrative, investigation, surveillance, and resource management.
Life is about to get a little meta…
Do you like power? How about controlling the lives of others?
Do you like breaking rules? Does it excite you? Maybe “Rebel” is your middle name?
Do you want to be part of an exclusive group? Be someone important?
Do you want to make some money and become rich?
If you answered yes to any of the above questions, you’re in luck! You've been invited to join The Primate Observation Club. Live out all your heart’s desires as the newest member and if you are already in the Club, it’s time to move up the ladder.
Observe the monkeys behind cages from the comfort of your home, stash some cash with your side hustle jobs, and maybe even play the role of a divine being by manipulating the lives of your subjects. Don’t hesitate, it’s time to make 2099 your year!
A Dystopian Dreamland
It’s 2099 and alien knowledge has caused rapid advancements in technology to the point that big corporations now sponsor planets. Stripped of resources, Earth is now a wasteland and humanity has spread across the galaxy. Humans, robots, and aliens now live side by side.
Spying Is Encouraged
The MonkeyVision app helps you manage hidden cameras and monitor cages. Make observations and search the internet to learn more about each subject. Need more cameras? Pick up side jobs for money, all the while avoiding that wacky conspiracy theorist next door.

critic.quote: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099 is an excellent blend of ideas and watching the various cage narrative is thrilling. There’s enough of them and they are randomized at the start of a new run, to encourage replayability. The game makes mass surveillance immersive and engaging, which is icky on a conceptual level but makes playing the game very fun. The survival and interference mechanics also mesh well

It offers a fun, well-balanced experience full of possibilities. It’s a game that will keep you glued to the screen while you’re precisely glued to the screen while watching the monkeys. This sequel offers many improved stuff the original game didn’t, and which certainly deserves the opportunity to be played.

I've spent the past few days completely hooked on Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099, and I think part of the reason is that, much like the game's protagonist, we all spend most of our day glued to a screen and working remotely.
Although not as surprising as the original (like pretty much every sequel), this title deliver another fantastic experience while we uncover its characters’ darkest secrets.

At first, the balancing act of Do Not Feed The Monkeys 2099 can feel quite overwhelming. Health decays at a faster rate than in the original, much to player detriment, and managing to keep it at a viable level while also paying the Council, buying new cages, and viewing feeds at their active times is quite the challenge. However, similarly to games like Papers, Please, it's very doable to make inc

Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099 is the sequel to the deduction and observation game that caught us by surprise a few years ago. It maintains its original essence, but incorporates new mechanics and content that add complexity to the development.[Recommended]

s.desc:
拥抱未知并穿越一个广袤的外星世界，其中充斥着怪异的生物、致命的危害以及冷酷的谜团。找寻救赎，并直面埋藏于被遗忘的普罗蒂亚六号行星深处的恐怖罪孽。
-探索一片超凡脱俗的废土之地
无论你是试图体验荒芜的地表，攀登致命、严寒的山峰，还是探查爬满了恶毒外星物种的研究设施，普罗蒂亚六号上隐藏着大量可供发掘的失传秘密，它们将会揭示你的先祖在两万年前灭绝的原因。每前进一步，都有危险在等着你。
-生存工具
借助魔卓拉的机敏灵活来翻滚、躲闪、跳跃、飞檐走壁，并以前所未有的速度冲刺，从而躲避致命的有机体和有害的恶劣天气。利用你的迅捷反应力、丰富的武器库以及特殊技能来全力求生，应对各种各样的低级别威胁，乃至会逼你使出浑身解数的巨怪。
-借助环境来实现进化
启动你的扫描仪机器人，使用X射线视野来更仔细地检查生物和你身处的环境。揭晓隐藏道路和肉眼不可见的秘密区域，并勾勒出已探索的地图片区。
轰飞不怀好意的生物和有机体以吸收其普罗托浆——一种充满能量的生物质包块。在有机腔室内消耗此物质来实现变形，并将你的技能和武器进化至新的等级。

《ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP》是一款NAMCO LIMITED（现Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.）于1996年发行的赛车游戏。
热门街机赛车游戏《ACE DRIVER》强势回归，速度更猛、刺激更强、竞争更激烈，比以往任何时候都更精彩！
在全新的赛道上驰骋，体验全面重制的赛车，挑战刺激且充满冲击力的赛道。
凭借真实的操控感和增强的游戏体验，每一圈都能带来节奏紧凑的顶级街机竞速体验。
坐上驾驶座，体验《ACE DRIVER》的全新进化！
《Arcade Archives》系列秉承忠实复刻经典街机游戏的理念开发，并搭载了难度与画面设置、回溯功能、连发模式及多存档位等便捷特性。玩家还可通过在线排行榜与全球玩家竞逐最高分数。
《Arcade Archives 2》在系列原有的“ORIGINAL MODE”、“HI SCORE MODE”、“CARAVAN MODE”基础上，新增“TIME ATTACK MODE”模式。在“TIME ATTACK MODE”中，玩家将不计分数全力竞速通关。新增的VRR（可变刷新率）支持功能，更能还原接近街机原版的流畅体验。
请尽情享受这些标志性的街机游戏吧！它们定义了一个时代，尽在“Arcade Archives”系列！
*本商品仅限PlayStation🄬5游玩。
除本商品外，还有PlayStation🄬4的《Arcade Archives ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP》。本商品的保存数据与PlayStation🄬4的《Arcade Archives ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP》不兼容，且与追加内容也不兼容。请注意不要购买重复商品或购买错误商品。
*如果您已经购买了 PlayStation🄬4《Arcade Archives ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP》，您将能够通过“游戏所有者折扣”购买 PlayStation🄬5《Arcade Archives 2 ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP》。

《RAIDEN PROJECT》SEIBU KAIHATSU于1995年推出，登陆32位家用游戏机平台。
作为超高空战斗轰炸机“RAIDEN”和“RAIDEN II”的飞行员，为拯救地球而战，抵御突然出现的外星生命体的侵略吧！
本作是一款正统的纵向卷轴射击游戏，收录了1990年发行的、曾引发轰动热潮的街机纵向卷轴射击游戏《RAIDEN》，以及三年后发售且同样广受欢迎的《RAIDEN II》。
“Console Archives”系列秉承忠实复刻经典理念，将各代家用游戏主机上的杰作搬上现代平台，让玩家轻松畅玩。
本系列配备丰富便捷功能：支持自定义按键布局与画面设置，并可随时保存/加载进度。
无论您是昔日玩家还是初次体验，敬请尽情享受这些塑造家用机游戏历史的经典之作！

她也是一片好心
“你订的那一大批鲜花送到了，我就帮你全都拆包了！”
侄女拿着备用钥匙，本来只想帮忙。花店明天就要开业了，你订的鲜花却散落了一地。没关系，你知道它们该放在哪里。
一次抱起一大束
把鲜花抱满怀，切换手中的花朵，再放进对应的花篮。每个花篮只装一种花，装满时还会提醒你。
布置属于你的花店
每个花篮都可以上色。选一种或多种颜色，画出条纹、交替排列，或点缀缤纷图案。最终的花店，由你亲手布置。
没有时间限制
没有分数，没有需要反复刷取的升级，也没有人在催促。随时停下来，下次回来继续整理。

你将扮演狐狸记者“托马斯”，在严酷的监狱中生存、探索和逃脱。努力收集证据，洗清冤屈。结交个性十足的囚犯，在阴谋重重的险境中闯出一条生路！卧底警探黑豹“鲍勃”现已登场，快来体验惊心动魄的CRPG冒险吧！
■电影感十足的硬汉派叙事
玩家将置身于动物之城，扮演遭受陷害的记者和执行卧底任务的警察，试着在严酷的监狱中生存下来。与监狱外的伙伴里应外合，收集证据，调查一切可疑的踪迹，在危难之中拯救自己和这座城市。
■内容庞大而充实的纯正CRPG
本作不仅为玩家可操作的两位主角各准备了超过20小时的精彩主线故事，还有3大监狱帮派，47名个性十足的囚犯，数十位特色各异的NPC，上百个精心设计的任务，多条体验迥异的越狱路线，外加丰富的结局分支，以及超过百万字的生动文本，这一切的元素将打造出前所未有的角色扮演体验！
■深入调查潜藏于监狱的秘密阴谋
看似井然有序的监狱，其实暗藏玄机？监狱角落的不速之客，食堂暗门后的诡异声响，走廊尽头那道永远上锁的门……收集蛛丝马迹，交易情报，在深夜宵禁时段展开冒险，与时间赛跑，揭开隐藏在监狱里的阴谋与秘密！
■沉浸感十足的牢狱生活体验
彻底融入这座庞大的监狱，严格遵守狱中规定，同时将它化为你的表演舞台，大展身手。探索陌生的环境，迎接种种未知的挑战。是当个安稳度日的模范囚犯，还是四处惹是生非大搞破坏，这一切都将由你决定。
■个性十足的登场角色
这座监狱里的每个角色都拥有令人难以忘怀的故事。要与他们交流合作、相互帮助（或相互利用），还是狠狠地踢他们的屁股，全看你的选择！当然也可以做个“独行侠”，或在各个势力间巧妙周旋。是贯彻正义还是耍点手段，而既然进了监狱，不妨试着入乡随俗。
■自由开放的成长系统
做个用拳头说话的硬汉，或是藏于阴影中的盗贼；想要巧舌如簧外加一点黑客技术？当然，在这里一切皆有可能。学习技能，收集装备，制作工具，试着从无名的菜鸟囚犯成长为耀眼的监狱之星吧！
■大开脑洞的越狱路线
从洗衣房到医务室，再到下水道和停车场，成功越狱的关键潜藏在监狱的每一处角落。发现每个场景中的秘密，然后善用它们，自由之路上，你的想象力将成为最有力的武器。

editions.name: 动物迷城 ～Back to the Dawn～

critic.quote: Back to the Dawn is one of the most unique indie RPGs I’ve played in recent memory—gritty, tense, mechanically rewarding, and full of well-developed characters who surprise you with their humanity, despite being cartoon animals. Its depiction of prison life is thoughtful and serious without relying on shock value, and the branching narrative gives your decisions real weight.

Back to the Dawn is a management RPG set in a prison populated by anthropomorphic animals, with strong survival elements. You have twenty-one days to organize an escape, keeping an eye on time, resources, social relationships, and skills. Every action consumes precious minutes and can influence future events. The turn-based combat system mirrors typical JRPG gameplay. Deep, branching, and challeng

Back to the Dawn is a smart, content-rich RPG that encourages creative problem-solving and experimentation. With two distinct protagonists, an open structure, and a wide cast of characters, it’s a great fit for players who love choice-driven gameplay and tactical planning. While some areas (like the combat system or portrayal of female characters) could use further depth, the overall experience is
For a game set in a jail, Back to the Dawn offers an impressive amount of freedom. Coupled with a conspiracy-minded story, and more side-quests you can shake a shiv at, you'll be hooked.
Metal Head takes the mechanics of time, skill and priority management very seriously, and delivers a rich, immersive and gripping narrative experience, with a gallery of engaging characters.
Back to the Dawn is a prison RPG with great in-game time mechanics, a good story and a lot of replayability. Some of its narrative choices, however, are a little too stereotypical.

s.desc:
欢迎来到一个奇幻又黑暗的世界，现实和梦境交织在一起，每个角落都潜伏着秘密……
《化妆镜》是一款超现实的独立冒险游戏，将带你踏上一段穿越神秘国度的旅程。在那里，凡事都没有表面这么单纯，所有事物都息息相关。
你扮演一个过去扑朔迷离的小女孩，在一间陌生又诡异的屋子里醒来，身边只有你手上的化妆镜。为了寻回记忆，你必须探索这栋建筑的扭曲走廊及房间、解决谜题、与独特的角色互动，并揭开关于你的身份以及邪恶力量的真相。
你有办法面对真相吗？
《化妆镜》具有美得令人难忘的美术风格、扣人心弦的配乐和引人入胜的故事情节，带来独一无二又难以忘怀的游戏体验。它会挑战你的思维、触动你的心灵，令你惊叹不已。
游戏特色
- 超现实且氛围独特的世界，满满的谜团和奇观等你一探究竟
- 有趣的谜题和挑战，考验你的技巧和逻辑
- 令人印象深刻又复杂的角色
- 多种路线与结局，取决于你的选择和行动
- 余音绕梁的优美配乐，令人沉浸于游戏氛围
- 丰富且深刻的世界观，满足探索欲和好奇心
- 一段刻骨铭心的自我发现、失落和希望之旅
绝对不要放开它，明白吗？

However, the narrative doesn’t ever seem fully realized, leaving a predictable and almost confusing experience. Regardless, it’s one that lasts with you with its gorgeous setpiece, horror elements, and intriguing cast.

Pocket Mirror: GoldenerTraum is a beautiful blast to the past that hearkens back to the glory days of the indie RPG Maker scene. What makes it shine is in its cast of colorful characters and its heartwarming message. Though I commented that its vagueness is detrimental to emotionally connecting with the story, it does linger with you as you ponder upon its meaning. Video games are art, and Pocket

s.desc:
不分敌我全部杀杀杀！死越多越强的养成型RTA模拟RPG 震撼登场！
本作以经典格子战棋模拟玩法为基础，搭载毫不留情牺牲同伴的残酷战斗系统"剥削侍从系统"，打造前所未有的全新 SRPG 体验。
作恶越多，军团就越凶残；罪行越深，攻略就越顺利！
夺回化为小嬰兒的邪神 "小吉猛" 的力量，击溃那些披着正义面具的虚假的神，让真正的邪恶君临天下吧！
■STORY
这是一个与我们所生活的地球不同，另一个地球的故事。
最强、最凶恶的邪神"吉猛"。
就在距离弑神只差最后一步之遥时……
某天，祂却突然变成了"小婴儿"——。
为了预防这种状况，邪神吉猛启动了 以防万一而熬夜开发的邪神复活程式，其名为"恶魔夜疯狂"。
是命运的恶作剧，还是必然？
被卷入这场诡异仪式的，是一名极度憎恨世界、毫不起眼的青年"邪龙院狂死狼"。
因双方利害关系一致，两人结成了奇妙的合作关系。
这是关于邪神吉猛，与成为邪神使徒的邪龙院狂死狼，两人的"恶"之故事。
■不分敌我全部杀杀杀！颠覆常识的战略对战！
利用在战斗中利用牺牲我方"侍从"的"剥削侍从系统"，尽情作恶吧！
亲手引爆手下的"屠杀技能"或是将其当作"祭品"等 这些残虐无情的战术，正是迈向胜利的最短捷径！
■恶行越多，力量越强！在基地自由培育、强化军团！
投入作恶赚取的"恶德点数" ，打造专属于你的最凶军团吧！
在有限的时间内，灵活运用可疑的"引诱"与"寻宝"等手段，将角色强化至极限吧！
■随剧情推进不断变化的世界！尽情体验各种恶行的剧情发展！
每击败一个章节的BOSS，游戏情境都将彻底改变！
"化身怪人击败战队英雄"、"化身魔女击溃魔法少女"等，亲身体验各种恶行带来的快感吧！

故事讲述了一位名叫 Ignat 的孤独青年，在一个黑暗而危险的后末日赛博朋克世界中求生。在一场悲剧性的军事冲突之后，仅存的少数幸存者不得不适应残酷的新现实。失去父母后，Ignat 学会了独自生活，并在这个无情的环境中建立自己的生活。
然而，当他收到一封意想不到的电子邮件时，他原本稳定的生活发生了巨大的变化……
《Hail to the Rainbow》是一款第一人称剧情驱动的冒险游戏，融合了恐怖与射击元素。游戏设定在一个细节丰富的世界中，玩家需要在全新的现实中生存，揭开混乱背后的秘密，并体验主角的记忆与内心挣扎。
探索环境、查看电子记录、解决技术谜题、收集物品并升级你的装备——这些都将是你旅程中不可或缺的要素。
特色：
- 由独立开发者 Sergey Noskov（《In rays of the Light》、《35MM》、《7th Sector》创作者）打造的新作
- 深刻的剧情与沉浸式世界
- 设定于后末日俄罗斯的震撼赛博朋克风格
- 合理的技术挑战与紧张刺激的战斗
- 通关后可解锁的额外内容
- 拍照模式
- 由 Nobody’s Nail Machine 创作的氛围音乐

s.desc:
踏入一个被疯狂吞噬的世界，每一次遭遇都是一场为了生存而进行的殊死搏斗。
《Mortal Sin》是一款残酷的第一人称 Roguelike 游戏，将迅捷、拳拳到肉的近战战斗与近乎无限的可重复游玩性完美融合。掌握毁灭性的连招，击溃源源不断的敌人，在不断变化、充满秘密、强力战利品与难以言喻恐怖的地下城中杀出一条血路。
没有任何两次冒险会完全相同。探索程序生成的世界，完成随机任务，并解锁不断扩充的独特职业阵容。每个职业都拥有专属武器、技能和截然不同的战斗风格。无论是挥舞巨剑粉碎敌人，还是手持双枪横扫梦魇，每一次挑战都将带来全新的生存方式。
凭借极具冲击力的漫画风艺术风格以及可完全自定义的视觉模式，《Mortal Sin》将带来一场充满风格且毫不留情的噩梦之旅。在这里，技巧决定一切，而自负只会带来死亡。

critic.quote: Mortal Sin is a skeletal roguelite, but the surprisingly meaty combat goes a long way to making up for that.

Mortal Sin is the first dungeon crawler I have ever played, and I now have very high expectations for the rest. This was because of Its fun and addictive combat, appealing graphics and well designed enemies and areas, just to name a few. There aren't many games that I review which I want to go back and put more hours in, however with Mortal Sin I can't help myself but want to experience more of th

Mortal Sin is a hidden roguelike gem that combines fast-paced combat, and striking visuals. Not for everyone, but its intense gameplay and replayability make it unforgettable for those willing to dive in. [Recommended]

s.desc:
Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror 是一款第三人称生存恐怖游戏，故事发生在架空历史中的1855年。
克里米亚战争仍在持续，英国政府为寻求新武器，将希望寄托于维克多·弗兰肯斯坦及其研究。然而，计划以失败告终，留下了远比任何人预想中更加危险的产物。
你在爱丁堡的一所军医院醒来，对自己遭遇的一切毫无记忆。你的任务是找到维克多·弗兰肯斯坦，阻止他继续研究。
随着你循迹追查，这场调查与你自身的联系也越来越深。诡异的生物似乎认得你，散落的文件让你的过去疑点重重，而弗兰肯斯坦实验背后的真相，也变得愈发难以回避。
探索阴暗而危机四伏的环境，搜寻补给，破解环境谜题，在弗兰肯斯坦失败实验的造物面前求得生存。弹药和治疗物品有限，每一场战斗都要付出代价。
使用左轮手枪和近战武器保护自己，避开致命陷阱，并采取不同策略击败各类敌人。
主要特色
• 融合探索、战斗与解谜的第三人称生存恐怖体验
• 以弗兰肯斯坦传说为灵感的原创故事
• 有限的弹药与资源，让每一次遭遇都至关重要
• 左轮手枪射击与近战搏斗
• 环境谜题、隐藏通道与致命陷阱
• 怪诞的敌人与首领战
• 围绕弗兰肯斯坦的实验与主角过往展开的黑暗谜团
• 哥特式场景，以及越接近真相就越令人不安的故事
• 由Unreal Engine 5驱动，呈现细致的环境、氛围感十足的光影与电影式恐怖体验
如您已经拥有该游戏的 PS4® 数字版，则可免费获得其 PS5® 数字版，无需额外付费购买。如您拥有 PS4® 制品版游戏，则需在下载游戏和每次游玩时将光盘放入 PS5® 主机内。如您拥有 PS4® 制品版游戏，但购买了无光驱的 PS5® 数字版主机，则无法免费获得该游戏的 PS5® 版本。

s.desc:
〈夺回Dr.Kirk作战〉结束后的一年。
拥有＂终极清洁能源＂与＂终极兵器＂两种特性的第三能量（Third Energy）。
这项计画已经脱离开发者Dr.Kirk之手，交由政府全面接管。
然而，＂事故＂再次发生——。
由于第三能量反应炉失控，规模远超上一次，令研究开发都市彻底消失。
政府为保护研究成果与相关人员，展开了救援行动。
利用尚未开发完成的＂时空转移（Time Gate）＂装置，将部队送往都市可能被转移到的时代。
——任务的最终结果，没有人能预测。
除了她──Regina。
本作的主角除了前作的＂Regina＂外，亦新增了＂Dylan＂。
可使用的武器种类更加丰富！登场的恐龙超过十种，同时袭来的恐龙数量亦加倍！
游戏舞台从前作以军事设施为中心的场景，拓展至白垩纪时代的世界。
丛林、洞窟、湖泊，被植物侵蚀的建筑等各种场景中，恐龙将不断向您袭来！

critic.quote: Graphically, Dino Crisis 2 boasts some of the best work the old PS will ever have to offer, with great CG flowing near seamlessly into the action the player controls.
I must say that Dino Crisis 2 is the most pleasing new experience in this whole Survival Genre yet.
One of the most refreshing takes on the third-person action shooter to date.
Offered a style of gameplay totally different than the original Dino Crisis. [Nov 2001, p.40]
Dino Crisis 2 serves up plenty of heart-thumping mayhem, awesome graphics and sound, and enough dinosaur bloodlust to keep even the most experienced dino hunters on their toes.
Great graphics and sound, tried-and-true gameplay, and wall-to-wall blasting mayhem make this a winner.

s.desc:
一款粗粝写实、由骰子驱动的角色扮演游戏，舞台是一座蒸汽朋克城市。你逃离了战争，但要如何活下去？探索这座城市。决定你该信任谁。谨慎抉择：你或许会点燃一场革命！
德雷奇港正逐渐失控。帮派统治着贫民窟，腐败凌驾于法律之上，战死者的尸体每天被焚烧充作燃料。你是一名退伍士兵，被误认为已经阵亡，随尸体一起被运回德雷奇港等待"处理"。九死一生逃脱之后，你孤身一人身陷城市的脏腑深处，名下只剩两样东西：你的性命和你的理智。想要两者兼得，绝非易事。
Duskpunk 的灵感源自桌面角色扮演游戏和叙事冒险游戏，在挑战与自由之间取得平衡，在你挣扎求生的过程中追踪你的健康、精力与压力。做出影响深远的抉择，决定这座城市的命运。培养技能，在你选择的行当中出人头地。挣口饭吃，探索城市，结交盟友，摆脱你伤痕累累的过去。
德雷奇港聚集着形形色色的人物，他们背景丰富，动机暧昧不明。有些人关心你或这座城市；另一些人只为自己打算，但出手阔绰。慎选盟友。无论你愿不愿意，他们都将成为你命运的一部分。c

critic.quote: By the time the game came to its conclusion, I was left with an overwhelming yearning for a better future, and a feeling that that is something wholly achievable. Duskpunk is the kind of game that makes me feel hope.

Duskpunk provides an engaging experience for those who enjoy decision-based story games. Strategy is still an important factor on how you play this game, but it’s all worth it to experience this game’s rich story. Take this with a grain of salt as I had been reviewing the demo of Duskpunk, so I am unaware of what’s to come after a certain point.

Duskpunk is an easy to grasp dice-based RPG with a good story to carry you along. It does make your character, who starts off with nothing, into someone that's far too important for too many factions very quickly, which undercuts the simple struggle to survive, but this does provide for some good story beats. If you enjoyed Citizen Sleeper, then you will probably enjoy Duskpunk.

s.desc:
《沙丘探险》是一款开放世界的动作冒险游戏，您和最多三位朋友将骑乘巨型蟹爬行者探索沙海。
与头罐子瓦萨尔作战，生存于成群的野生虫子中，探索绿洲岛屿，深入阴险的地牢，帮助您的同伴波洛伊朝圣者赢得对抗陶艺师入侵的战争！
主要特点
合作与单人游戏：
与最多4名玩家在本地或在线合作中冒险，或在幽灵伙伴的帮助下独自踏上荒原！
开放世界探索：
驾驶您的沙丘爬行者穿越沙漠，访问数十个岛屿以完成任务，探索秘密地牢，收集大量战利品！
升级您的武器库：
通过收集面具、外套和护符获得强大的新玩家能力！解锁像嗡嗡炮和酸鱼叉这样的武器！为您的沙丘爬行者配备尖刺装甲腿和导向鱼雷等升级（或者只给她换个新帽子和运动涂装）！
甲壳类战斗：
与您的船员一起操控炮台和舵，抵抗其他爬行者、巨型首领和岛屿堡垒的攻击！装填炮弹，修复受损的腿，甚至在空中发射自己进行大胆的登船行动！
骑乘巨虫：
巨型螃蟹可不是你唯一的节肢动物坐骑！和朋友们一起骑上配有多个鞍座的甲虫，驾驭疾行的若虫四处飞驰，或骑着身披重甲的蝎子和球虫冲破一切阻碍！
惊险刺激的战斗：
有时候，脚踏实地作战才是最佳选择！使用各式手持武器和道具，帮助波洛伊同胞击退附庸军入侵者，或利用炸弹花、蜂巢和蜘蛛卵等当地致命的动植物迎击敌人！

critic.quote: DuneCrawl is an exceptional open-world exploration game that allows players to indulge in the fantasy of piloting giant crab war machines. While lacking a bit in exciting progression mechanics and harder to engage with as a solo player, this game is otherwise solid all around and has an incredible fantasy world and visual aesthetic.

DuneCrawl is an interesting game that blends together giant crab combat, dungeoneering and multiplayer shenanigans. It's fun enough, but I really wish it did a little bit more with the more unusual aspects of its game design.

DuneCrawl is an ambitious indie with a striking concept and stylish presentation, but it struggles to stay engaging due to repetitive gameplay and uneven execution. The chaotic co-op shines when played with a full group of friends, yet solo or duo play quickly exposes sluggish AI and design friction. At its price point it’s a fair deal, but only if you can convince others to join the crawl.
At first glance, this appears to be a game with a clear and confident vision, but playing it for a period of time reveals how much it's split between underdeveloped mechanics. [Issue#420, p.100]

users.author: RedDuelist
users.quote: Had a lot of fun with the combat and riding the dune crab. You can both ride more smaller animals and can fully control the dune crabs when you become the crab keeper.

users.author: Pythz
users.quote: Un petit projet sympathique bien qu'il manque un peu de profondeur. On se prête rapidement au jeu tout de même, la coopération prend tous son sens lors des affrontements contre les crabes ou les avant-postes. Quelques mécaniques mériteraient d'être approfondies. Une dizaine d'heures de contenu, de quoi largement satisfaire les curieux.

s.desc:
Island Market Simulator 是一款最多支持4人合作的策略经济模拟游戏。与好友组队、分工协作、管理生产链，携手打造繁荣的贸易帝国；也可以按自己的节奏单人游玩。
在 Island Market Simulator 中，您将从岛镇上的小市场起步，逐步建立庞大的贸易帝国。用丰富多样的独特装饰品（画作、家具、配饰）精心布置您的家，提升声望，展示个人风格。在货架上陈列琳琅满目的商品，巧妙布局以扩大客户群、最大化收益。游戏拥有四季变化和雪、雨、酷暑等动态天气，彻底改变农耕节奏和市场需求。您可以种植多种多样的作物，通过优化播种、灌溉和收获流程获取最高产量；饲养牲畜以生产牛奶、羊毛、鸡蛋和肉类，同时确保它们的健康与幸福。每逢季节庆典或特殊活动，您都能获得稀有奖励和惊喜机会，保持活跃，不错过任何优势。完成王国、海盗和居民发布的任务，解锁新区域和剧情；您的选择将影响阵营关系并触发独特事件，所有机制紧密交织，让您以策略塑造自己的岛屿贸易帝国。

在繁星之上，一位天使和一位恶魔围绕着一块闪闪发光的棋盘盘旋，用云朵展开一场关于世间最古老争论的较量。
两人轮流沿棋盘边缘飞翔，选择一行或一列，然后从两端任一端将自己的云朵抛入棋盘。你的云朵落在第一个格子上，其路径上的所有内容都会向后滑动一格。若空间耗尽，远端的那片云会被彻底推下边缘，在那里化作一道光雨。
若能用自己的云组成一条完整直线——横向、纵向或对角线——你便获胜。
关键在于，没有任何东西会永远停留在你放置的位置。对手的每次投掷都可能将你精心排列的行列推散，或将你自己的某片云推入你从未计划过的线路中。看似无望的棋局，可能因一次推挤而逆转。没有绝对安全的格子，只有对手尚未触及的格子。
两条自定义规则让对决持续推进：任何人不得连续三次打出相同的棋步，也不得通过将同一条线直接推回的方式回应对手的棋步。没有僵局，没有无休止的拉锯战——只有位置、压力和果断出手的勇气。
随心所欲地游玩
在每场比赛开始前，按自己的喜好设置棋盘：
- 棋盘大小——3×3 适合快节奏的近身肉搏，4×4 和 5×5 适合真正的策略对决，6×6 则适合旷日持久的消耗战
- 棋盘初始填充度——从 0% 的空棋盘开始，或直接跳入 30%、60% 或 90% 填充度的混乱战场
- 选择阵营 — 选择天使的白云阵营或恶魔的雷云阵营；对手将选择另一阵营
- 操控方 — 每方均可由玩家或主机控制，因此可以进行玩家对战、挑战电脑，或坐下来观看两个 AI 相互厮杀
- 四种难度等级的对手
初学者、新手、有经验者和专家。即便是最温和的对手也会提前几步思考并设置陷阱——难度更高的对手则完全不会犯错。专家级对手能预判六步，对任何松散的云朵都不会手下留情。
特色
- 单人或双人游戏，并肩在同一台主机上对战
- 四种棋盘尺寸和四种初始填充方式——共十六种对局设置方式
- 四种难度等级，对手具备真正的思考能力
- 所有棋盘尺寸均计入对角线
- 每种棋盘尺寸下，系统都会记录你与主机的对战战绩
- 即时重赛——获胜后，棋盘清空，即可再次对战

踏入斗兽场，与朋友们锁链相连。
CHAINED BEASTS 是一款 1至4人合作的角斗士 Roguelike 游戏，结合了残酷的战斗、团队合作与荒诞滑稽的时刻。你能否召集伙伴、击碎敌人、赢得观众，并夺回自由？
角斗士战斗
在这款残酷的角斗士 Roguelike 中劈砍敌人，或利用环境来反制他们。向敌人掷出陶罐，或把敌人丢向陶罐。将他们撞入带刺的墙壁或蛇坑之中。投掷武器可远距离击倒敌人，但请确保手边还有另一件武器，否则你可能陷入险境。
与伙伴锁链相连
不要独自奋战，召集四位凶猛的伙伴，你们将以残酷又富创意的方式被锁在一起。若无法协调，你们可能会纠缠在柱子上，甚至更糟。但若步调一致，你们就能绊倒敌人，逆转局势。
对抗残暴首领
随着声名的提升，你将面对残暴的首领，竞技场中的英雄，他们武装到牙齿，拥有一切优势。局势将极度不利于你，但胜利会让你离罗马更近一步，迎来自由或复仇的机会。
挣扎于恐怖伤痛
竞技场的每一天都会让你增添新的伤口与痛苦。拖着受伤的腿前行，带着失去左眼的视野求生，或在幻觉中胡乱挥舞。药剂或许能缓解痛楚，但副作用可能让你陷入更严重的折磨。也许手术才是唯一的出路。
苦难淬炼性格
不要失去希望，在竞技场的磨炼中，你也能被锻造成残酷的战士。学习强大的技能以击败敌人。赢得观众，他们将永远为你呐喊助威。积攒金币，购买能扭转战局的装备与武器。解锁拥有强大能力的新角色。每一次战斗，都将迫使你踏上不同的道路。

critic.quote: Chained Beasts stands out for its inventive chain mechanic and demanding cooperative gameplay, but as a roguelike, it quickly falls into the trap of repetitiveness. A solid foundation isn't enough when successive runs offer too little variety or incentive to keep playing.

s.desc:
《孤独医院：启示录》是一款黑暗的第三人称生存恐怖游戏，恐惧、暴力和令人不安的秘密潜伏在每一扇门后。
在初代《孤独医院》的恐怖事件之后，这座废弃的医院成为了一个骇人谜团的中心。它的墙壁之下发生了可怕的事情——而真相本不该被揭开。
重返医院，揭开隐藏在废弃走廊和被遗忘房间里的黑暗真相。小心探索，解开令人不安的谜题，寻找必要的资源，消灭恐怖的僵尸，不惜一切代价在这场噩梦中生存下来。

注意：
本作并非《去月球》的续作，而是一个小型实验项目。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
由《去月球》以及《寻找天堂》创作者打造：简单的无对白小作，时长约一小时，讲述了一个男孩发现一只受伤小鸟的故事，带您走进一段现实与想象交织的旅程。
《鸟的故事》是一部互动像素动画，唯一的初衷就是讲述一个简单的故事。它是一部独立的叙事作品，拥有自己的开篇和结局。

critic.quote: A Bird Story is a fantastic and short pixel art visual novel that you need to experience.
A beautiful short story about friendship, that serves as a link between To the Moon and its successor.
A small, simple, but incredibly affecting story that showcases the power of the ability to encourage empathy through the most basic expressions of humanity and imagination.

Shorter game time, simplified story and a little less emotion - still, A Bird Story is the masterpiece of the narration and the form. But somehow it is something we had already seen in better shape before.
A beautiful tale about friendship that is far from the quality of To the Moon. Its null interactivity and simple narrative are its worst enemies.
A Bird Story is not the great follow-up that we could expect from the team that created the beautiful To the Moon, but its a warn story about friendship involving a kid and a bird.

users.author: Second-of-Relax
users.quote: A short story, without text but ... with a lot of feeling. You will not stop playing it until you finish it, and surely you will spend a while thinking about your pet or the pet that you had as a child.

users.author: Daitya
users.quote: Este no es un juego principal de la saga de "To the moon" es más para adentrarnos en el segundo episodio del mismo. Específicamente conocer el pasado del protagonista del segundo juego. En este sentido el juego es esencial ya que creará una vinculación con este personaje que será notoria en "Finding paradise". Creando una experiencia maravillosa y muy emotiva.

users.author: Darkstar01
users.quote: This was more of a story than a game, it was like a little interactive storybook. I guess there is some control required for the game, but the game itself is mostly passive and the viewer (you) is just the audience.

users.author: MissingNo000
users.quote: More than a game it is simply a story told where you do not have to do practically anything except move a few meters every now and then. As a ferryman game to the sequel to to the moon I must say that it is also enjoyable and, as we have been accustomed, tearful even if not too much given its duration of 1 hour

s.desc:
两款趣味十足的动作游戏，等你来挑战最高分。
母鸡会下蛋！但它们从不在同一个地方下蛋。试着在篮子里接住尽可能多的鸡蛋，刷新最高分吧。
抓住小鸡！小家伙们逃出了鸡窝，需要由鸡妈妈把它们找回来。不过要小心，那只狗正伺机而动。

数百万玩家玩过《Croc's World》系列的前作，现在轮到《Croc's World 5》登场了！
克罗克回来了，这一次，整片关卡都动了起来。60 个纯手工打造的关卡中，等待你的是全新的敌人、庞大的 Boss 战，以及两项全新玩法：持续移动的关卡区块，需要你算准跳跃时机；还有重力区域，让克罗克直接沿着天花板继续奔跑。
游戏特色：
4 座岛屿，60 个风格各异的关卡！
全新：重力区域 —— 在部分区段沿着天花板行走！
全新：持续移动的关卡区块 —— 算准你的跳跃时机！
画面大幅提升
4 个不同世界：沼泽、希腊、埃及与玛雅
4 个凶狠的 Boss
每个关卡最多可收集 3 颗星星
带 CRT 屏幕效果的复古模式，重现纯正 80 年代氛围
大量富有挑战性的敌人

《Nightmare: The Lunatic》是
一款格挡动作rogue-lite平台游戏，
讲述的是如何逃离永无止境的噩梦。
你受困于永无止境的噩梦之中。
为了逃离梦魇，
你必须探索如同仓鼠转轮般不断重复的梦境，
并抵达它的尽头。
在同样受困于噩梦之中的梦境商人的帮助下，
加入战斗 ，消灭噩梦之源 。
▶ 快速而华丽的战斗
使用冲刺、闪避和格挡等动作
躲避并反击游荡在梦魇中的强大怪物。
▶ BOSS战期间你一刻也不能放松警惕
击败守卫在各处的BOSS，找到逃离梦魇的线索。
攻击华丽且多样的劲敌正严阵以待。
▶ 玩家的专属武器组合
你最多可以选择三种武器，
并根据情况切换武器进行战斗。
可根据个人喜好或效率自由组合。
▶ ROGUE-LITE
每次游玩时地下城的布局都会发生变化，
玩家总能以全新的感受享受探索的乐趣。
游戏结束后会重新开始。
▶强化自身的RPG元素
透过每次冒险，玩家可以解锁新的契约并强化能力，
玩家也可以建立自己的角色搭配
并强化他们的基本技能。

critic.quote: Experimenting with Nightmare: The Lunatic's weapons, builds, and options make it one supremely enjoyable and customisable action game.

s.desc:
经典生存恐怖游戏重新浮出了水面
《重金属死亡罐头》是一款复古风格的生存恐怖游戏。游戏发生在一艘瑞典潜艇之内，而背景则是架空历史的上世纪70年代末。 被困在挪威海深处的你必须为了生存而战斗，去抵抗能够将你的船员变成可怕僵尸的污泥病毒。 搜寻幸存者，并揭开这一切疯狂背后的真相
正统生存恐怖游戏的回归
踏入这场幽闭而锈迹斑斑的噩梦吧，其灵感来自于PS1时代那些定义了生存恐怖的经典作品。 有限弹药、固定视角、模拟恐怖，船舱的每一次作响都可能是你听见的最后一次。
固定视角。 真正的紧迫感。
没人会来牵住你的手。 不会有任何人替你殿后。 你的恐惧会是油然而生的。
物资管理很重要。
管理好逐渐稀少的物资、临时钥匙，以及从往日回忆中浮现的纪念之物。 每一发子弹都很关键——但它们永远都不够用。
复古的美术风格。
本作的美术风格从上世纪90年代末的恐怖与冒险游戏中汲取了许多灵感，再将现代的渲染技术融合进去。
一个充斥着死亡的铁罐头
发掘出HMS多姆赫伦号上所发生的一切背后的骇人真相。  每条走廊都能揭示惊天阴谋的些许碎片......还有一些不太类人的东西。
架空历史。 北欧黑暗风遇上深海恐惧症。
全身心投入到这一架空设定中的瑞典吧，宜人的文化符号将与生硬的钢铁工业风格形成鲜明对比。
一群讨人喜欢的幸存者。
在游戏中，你将会遇到其他幸存者——比如神秘的米尔顿和自暴自弃的船长奥拉夫——他们每一个人都有着自己的小算盘和不堪回首的过去。信任来之不易，但只有合作才有机会活着回家。
来自深渊的音乐。
沉浸在扭曲的吉他音、合成音乐，以及令人不安的沉寂之中吧。 每一个音符都在为你的棺材钉上一颗钉子。
游戏特色：
- 传统恐怖风格与超现实主义的瑞典潜艇相结合，组成了这款带有早期主机风格的生存恐怖游戏。
- 固定视角和坦克式操控方式（也有现代操作选项）为游戏更加增添了几分恐怖氛围。
- 在来之不易的信任和怪奇的遭遇之中探索充满转折的故事。
- 上世纪90年代风格的恐怖游戏，辅以现代渲染技术。
- “70年代末的瑞典海军”这一独特的背景设定将给你带来一种架空历史的错乱感。
你能活着回家吗？
WARNING: THIS ARTICLE CONTAINS MATERIAL WHICH MAY OFFEND AND MAY NOT BE DISTRIBUTED, CIRCULATED, SOLD, HIRED, GIVEN, LENT, SHOWN, PLAYED OR PROJECTED TO A PERSON UNDER THE AGE OF 18 YEARS
警告： 本物品內容可能令人反感；不可將本物品派發、傳閱、出售、出租、交給或出借予年齡未滿18歲的人士或將本物品向該等人士出示、播放或放映。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: A superb throwback to old-school mechanics tied together with brilliant writing and compelling gameplay.

Heavy Metal Death Can won't appeal to everyone, and the game is deliberately old-fashioned. Often to such an extent that it negatively affects the experience. But if you're one of those who genuinely yearn for something that feels 30 years old, and who fully embrace the genre as it was back then in the late 90s, then Heavy Metal Death Can could very well be the perfect game for you.

s.desc:
在《Desolus》这款第一人称解谜游戏中，探索一座哥特式城市，徘徊于过去与未来之间。
一场神秘的大灾难裂开了现实，打开了通往其他时代的传送门。探索广袤城市的过去和未来。
利用黑洞解决埃舍尔式的谜题，在时间中来回穿梭，使建筑重新归于完整。
随着现实的扭曲和时间变得越来越不稳定，在超现实的建筑中穿梭，挑战你的空间思维。
激活全息图像，在崩塌的大教堂楼层之间移动巨大的传送门，让你穿越仅部分存在于同一时间的建筑。
与城市守护者合作，阻止一场可能将过去和未来融为一体的大灾难。从末世灾难中拯救德索勒斯城。

建立并管理属于你自己的动物训练中心吧！
欢迎各类动物前来，为它们营造一个安全、温馨的环境，让它们在这里学习、玩耍并茁壮成长。设计并扩建你的训练中心，配备障碍赛道、训练设备、游乐区、等候室以及针对每种动物需求量身定制的专用空间。
训练只是工作的一部分。为毛茸茸的小伙伴们梳理毛发、洗澡、抚摸并给予奖励，以此赢得它们的信任，帮助它们充分发挥潜力。教授指令、提升技能，并为每只独一无二的动物探索最适合的训练方法。
提升您的声誉，解锁新设施，并让最优秀的学员为激动人心的比赛做好准备。从一家小型本地训练中心到世界闻名的目的地，每一份成功都始于您对动物的关爱与奉献。

重新打开玩具箱，备鞍上马，化身为胡迪、巴斯光年和杰茜，在《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》中展开一场3D冒险。这款游戏根据2010年热门动画电影《玩具总动员3》改编，更新后不仅拥有更精美的画面，更隐藏了一些新的惊喜。在剧情模式中亲身演绎电影里的经典桥段，或进入玩具盒模式，在胡迪的牛仔乐园中自由探索西部沙盒世界。
在剧情模式中，你将在胡迪、巴斯和杰茜之间自由切换，亲历电影中的标志性场景，包括火车营救、游乐行动、垃圾场逃生等等。发挥每个角色的独特能力，例如用胡迪的拉线摆荡，或借助巴斯的蛮力将其他玩具扔出老远。你还可以双人合作畅玩游戏。
走出剧情模式，进入玩具盒模式的沙盒世界。这个深受粉丝喜爱的自定义模式将你投入胡迪牛仔乐园的西部荒野。和剧情模式一样，你将扮演胡迪、巴斯或杰茜，但在玩具盒模式里，你可以随心所欲地发挥自己的想法！镇上的角色会向你发布任务，完成后可赚取金币，按自己的喜好来打造小镇。建造、装饰并定制建筑，给镇民们换装等等，还有更多精彩内容等你来发现。
《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》还纳入了此前仅限特定版本的独占内容。现在，玩家可以在玩具盒模式中扮演邪恶皇帝扎克，并解锁四个额外的主题包来装饰玩具盒。此外，完整版还升级了画面、分辨率和帧率。
游戏特色
- 在《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》中重温这款备受粉丝喜爱的游戏。
- 在剧情模式中重历从安迪的房间到阳光托儿所等的电影精彩桥段。
- 在胡迪、巴斯光年和杰茜之间切换，每个角色都有不同的能力，需要灵活运用才能通关。
- 投入玩具盒模式的沙盒世界。为玩具伙伴们执行任务，给镇民换装，装饰建筑等等。
- 与好友进行本地双人合作，可在剧情模式或玩具盒模式下进行。
- 所有版本现在都包含此前独占的内容，例如在玩具盒模式中扮演扎克皇帝。

critic.quote: With a diverse set of gameplay areas, countless missions, challenges, and collectibles, and the unlimited potential of the Toy Box mode, Toy Story 3 is easily one of the best movie-license games of all times and the perfect way to enhance the film trilogy and carry on the exploits of these delightful and entertaining characters to infinity and beyond…

Toy Story 3 isn't perfect, with some loose controls and a dull plotline to follow, seemingly more for the convention of having a plot in these games than anything else. The Toy Box mode adds a whole lot to the game, however, propelling it far beyond what a typical tie-in game offers.
The co-op levels and action bits are okay, but the Toy Box is magical stuff indeed. [Sept 2010, p.103]

Toy Story 3 is an example of how to do a license right. With great cooperative play, a short, fun story mode, and an inventive new Toy Box mode, this is one game that's easy to recommend to anyone who games with family.
One of the best kids games on 360 but, unusually for Pixar, with little grown-up appeal.  [Oct 2010, p.99]
Toy Story isn't just a game for kids; fans of the trilogy should have no reservations about picking this one up.
