s.desc:
与胡迪、巴斯光年等经典角色一起重返安迪的房间——《Toy Story: Retro Roundup!》来了！这款五合一游戏合集收录了早期玩具总动员的四款游戏（其中包括多款不同的主机和掌机版本），外加游戏《A Bug’s Life》。所有游戏均经过升级，加入了新功能、体验优化以及满满的幕后内容。重温90年代及21世纪初你最爱的经典之作，将这些作品分享给新一代的《Toy Story》粉丝。
畅玩游戏《Toy Story》(1995)、《Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!》(1999)、《Toy Story 2》(1999)、《Buzz Lightyear of Star Command》(2000)、《Toy Story Racer》(2001) 以及《A Bug’s Life》(1998)。游戏横跨主机与掌机共11个版本，且均经升级，优化了体验，其中包括回溯、雷克斯秘籍等功能。善用回溯功能，在安迪的书架上跳跃失误或遭受发条机器人过多伤害时，你便能轻松回溯重试。使用雷克斯秘籍可解锁游戏专属增强功能，如无限生命或无敌状态等。
走进Digital Eclipse的幕后，独家专访皮克斯故事总监Jason Katz、配音演员Jim Hanks、迪士尼与皮克斯游戏副总裁兼总经理Luigi Priore、TT Games创始人Jon Burton——他们共同造就了一趟又一趟精彩纷呈的冒险之旅。探索一座详尽的虚拟博物馆，其中陈列着罕见的设计文档、过去的开发照片以及档案资料。我们还收录了合集中每款游戏的完整原声音乐，你可以使用音乐播放器舒心聆听最喜欢的游戏歌曲。
游戏特色
- 畅玩五款经典游戏，包括四款《Toy Story》作品以及游戏《A Bug’s Life》横跨主机和掌机的共11个游戏版本。
- 增强功能和体验优化，让各年龄层玩家都能轻松上手、快速理解。
- 使用回溯功能修正失误。跳歪了？受到了太多的伤害？按住按钮，回溯进度，再来一次。
- 幕后体验，全新专访：皮克斯故事总监Jason Katz、配音演员Jim Hanks、迪士尼与皮克斯游戏副总裁兼总经理Luigi Priore、TT Games创始人Jon Burton。
- 探索虚拟博物馆，里面摆满了罕见的设计文档、过去的开发照片及档案资料。
- 使用雷克斯秘籍！体验无限生命、无敌状态，或解锁全部角色/关卡。
- 借助增强版操作指南学习游戏，随后在练习模式中磨练技巧。
- 通过音乐播放器聆听合集中每款游戏的完整原声音乐。

critic.quote: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! is another banger of a remaster collection from the best studio doing it, but it's also an incredibly validating slice of the culture that is often overlooked or mocked – the "movie game." By paying respects to the artists making monuments out of marketing, Digital Eclipse has put together a remarkable package full of great games, and great insights.

Toy Story: Retro Roundup is an incredibly well put-together compilation of some underrated classics from Disney Interactive Studios. A vast majority of the games within the collection have held up particularly well, and are given more room to shine thanks to the behind the scenes features. While not every game has stood the test of time, the abundance of new quality-of-life options means that even

In its careful historical preservation and attention to detail, Toy Story: Retro Roundup! is flawless. However, this unwavering fidelity to the past carries the weight of decades: without adjustments to soften the impact of the years and relying only on a few external tricks to overcome its limitations, both outdated mechanics and visuals may frustrate those seeking even a minimal contemporary exp

Ultimately, Retro Roundup & Toy Story 3: Complete Edition is a package that, while certainly not without its flaws, sets the standard for how collections of classic video games should be handled. We would have appreciated the option to play the Italian versions of the older Toy Stor* games, as well as the inclusion of some significant extra content for the remaster of the third installment; howeve
Toy Story: Retro Roundup! is a great compilation, as it includes almost all the major games in the series, along with several interesting extras.
Toy Story: Retro Roundup offers nostalgic fun and handy extras, though uneven games and rough presentation hold it back.

s.desc:
虚妄之盒是一款刺激爽快、节奏明快的 Roguelike 卡牌游戏。打造一支势不可挡的棋子大军，连出超强连击，享受无限可能！
自由搭配，组出各种精彩策略
• 打造一支势不可挡的棋子大军，提升它们的属性，击败最强大的 Boss！
• 串连各种能力，释放华丽连击，连续行动，打出巨量伤害……一切皆有可能！

打造无敌牌组

s.desc:
踏上前往奇幻世界特拉底亚的难忘旅程，在这里，宁静的农场生活与惊心动魄的冒险交织在一起！
你在宁静祥和的花绽村中成长，而如今，你的生活即将迎来巨大的改变。神秘的迷雾从回音森林中蔓延而出，野兽在夜幕下四处徘徊，奇异的灾害也开始威胁这片土地上的各个村庄。
探索广阔而充满生机的世界，发现隐藏的洞穴、遥远的岛屿、热闹的城镇，以及被遗忘已久的秘密。在旅途中，经营你的农场，饲养动物，收获作物，并打造一个属于自己的家园。在丰收女神的指引下，以及一路相遇的伙伴们的帮助下，你将找到成长、探索，以及帮助他人的全新方式。
随着季节更替，彼此之间的羁绊逐渐加深，隐藏在迷雾背后的真相也将慢慢浮现。在你帮助过的人们，以及陪伴你前行的伙伴们的支持下，你或许能够找到驱散回音森林迷雾的方法，让特拉底亚再次焕发生机！
• 恋爱与关系：结识10位独具魅力的恋爱对象——5位男性候选人和5位女性候选人。加深彼此之间的羁绊，体验感人至深的特别事件，并找到能够与你共度一生的理想伴侣。
• 动物伙伴系统：与各种各样的动物伙伴建立友谊，每种伙伴都拥有独特能力，帮助你展开探索。破坏障碍物，前往隐藏地点，并与你的伙伴一起发现特拉底亚的秘密。
• 全新的探索能力：跳跃、攀爬梯子、沿藤蔓向上攀爬，探索曾经无法到达的区域。结合你的移动能力与动物伙伴的特殊能力，尽情探索世界的每一个角落。
• 让大家都幸福起来：帮助村民，完成委托，并为特拉底亚的发展贡献力量，获得珍贵的快乐能量。收集的快乐能量越多，丰收女神就越能帮助恢复这片土地。
• 岛屿生活：收集航海图，发现遥远的岛屿。寻找隐藏的宝藏，探索全新的地点，并与只有在特拉底亚才能遇见的稀有动物成为朋友。
• 未驯服的荒野：荒野中生活着狼、熊、老虎以及其他野生动物。时刻保持警惕，避免被它们发现，否则你将失去收集到的物品，并回到自己的农场醒来。

critic.quote: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is a step up from its predecessor, introducing more vertical terrain and dense maps that make for rewarding exploration. Seeing the series continue to focus less on farming is an interesting pivot but I'm having a ton of fun with it.

I was initially hesitant to step back into the progenitor of the cozy farming genre, but I thoroughly enjoyed my time in Teradea. The open-world setting was a clear highlight, and finding exploration to be as deep and rewarding as the farming and relationship-building mechanics kept me far more invested than I expected from a game without combat. Echoes of Teradea provides a compelling gameplay lo

Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is another fine entry in the Harvest Moon series. It builds on the familiar formula of cultivating crops, tending to animals, gathering resources, building relationships and much more. There is plenty to keep you busy, and the new approach of weaving an overarching narrative into the experience works well. Unfortunately, the experience is marred by a very poor techn
Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea doesn’t break new ground in the genre, but it is still a cozy experience. There is some actual urgency in the game, but it does not run well on the Nintendo Switch 2.

s.desc:
啦嗒铛是一款融合了节奏跟横轴动作，可以最多四人一起合作的Roguelike节奏动作游戏。
有100种以上的角色一起展开激烈的大乱斗。
伴随着充满动态节奏感的BGM一起打败敌人吧！
每个人都可以透过节奏与动作结合的惊心动魄的战斗来享受最有趣的冒险。
欢迎来到啦嗒港！
在浩瀚宁静的大海上，有一座像玩具盒一样热闹的岛屿。岛屿的名字是「啦嗒港」
在岛上，一种叫啦嗒铛的疑似动物的奇怪生物跟它们的朋友们一起幸福快乐地生活。
尽管外表和个性各不相同，他们有着一个共同的梦想。
那就是前往「天国」。并遇见据说住在天国的「女神」。
作为肩负着所有人希望的英雄，啦嗒铛们踏上了通往天国的旅程。
无论失败多少次都不会放弃，梦想有一天能见到女神。
动作节奏
配合着音乐输入节奏指令，自由自在地操控着歌宝们吧。
由于啦嗒铛自身能够自由移动，因此在哪里下达指令、将啦嗒铛安置在哪里及何时撤退的判断很关键。
2D动画
我们更注重在2D动画上特有的表现，把活泼的个性投入在动作中。

critic.quote: Ratatan takes everything that was good about its spiritual predecessor and applies it to a faster, roguelike experience that really grooves.

Though the lack of local co-op and some balance issues keep the game from reaching legendary status, Ratatan is still a must-play – especially if you’ve even dipped a toe into Patapon’s world. This is a spiritual successor through and through, nicely evolved with its new gameplay elements and exciting battles. Plus, it looks and sounds like a true entertainer should, running smoothly on the Ninten

Ratatan is a welcome injection of weird into the Switch 2 roster. Hiroyuki Kotani builds on the legacy of Patapon with an addictive musical strategy title that will have “Rata” and “Un-Taka” rattling around your brain long after you walk away from your console. It will please fans of the developer's previous rhythm-action strategy, while offering something fresh and challenging for newcomers. It’s

While not perfectly polished, Ratatan does more than live up to Patapon's whimsical legacy. It takes the delightful rhythm action the PSP gem is known for, and elevates it with roguelike elements that pair with the core gameplay perfectly. The loss of Japan Studio and its excellent experimental games has been keenly felt over the last five years, but new releases like Slitterhead, Ratatan, and eve

As an initial experiment, this Patapon revival works well, though it needs some tweaking—particularly regarding variety and controls. From a technical standpoint, it is certainly not a game worth nitpicking, especially given its price point; having played it on the Nintendo Switch 2, we encountered no performance issues and particularly enjoyed the handheld experience. The artists at Ratata Arts h

Ratatan is a delightful experience that brings back what made the rhythm action and strategy Patapon games so memorable and adds a roguelite structure to the gameplay. Thanks to a marvellous art style, an engaging progression system and an exquisite soundtrack, Ratatan is an absolute charm for fans of the original formula, even if at some moments the on screen action can become visually too packed

s.desc:
你曾为拿破仑效力。你曾为拿破仑献出生命。现在，你为了拿破仑起死回生。
你是威廉，一名拿破仑大军团的士兵，你从一个战场坟墓中被唤醒。然而，你眼前的欧洲已不再是你为之牺牲的那片土地。一场神秘的瘟疫此刻正席卷整个大陆，而你之所以会重生，正是因为其腐朽之力在你的血管中奔涌。
驾驭腐朽之力
每一次死亡都是变得更强的契机。熟练掌握由格挡、冲刺和血腥终结技构成，涉及各式武器的战斗系统。正确引导你的力量来强化攻击并解锁新的超自然技能，并将其施展到你的敌人身上。
秘密遍布于战场之上
游走于一段19世纪的平行世界历史之中，在这里无休止的战争早已令整片大地满目疮痍。使用你新获得的机动能力，智取被瘟疫支配的拿破仑永恒卫队怪物，并发现环境中隐藏的秘密，它们可能会提高你的生存机会。
揭露一场惊天阴谋
亲历一个引人入胜的故事，在这个故事里历史人物和现实与恐怖和超自然元素彼此纠缠不清。探索黑暗角落之外的世界，揭露这场瘟疫与你的邪恶重生背后的真相。

critic.quote: Valor Mortis has become a new favorite of mine. While the game does have its flaws, mostly in the visual clarity of enemy attacks, the problems are so minuscule that they didn’t affect my enjoyment. An inspired setting, a unique twist on the formula, and some incredible body horror make Valor Mortis one hell of a title.

Rather than merely borrowing ideas—from Dark Souls and Dishonored to Sunset Overdrive and even Frogger—One More Level blends them with their own strengths and an original setting to create something truly unique.
Featuring buttery smooth play, fans of first-person melee filled with impactful and meaty combat shouldn't hesitate to check out Valor Mortis.

Valor Mortis proves first-person combat and the soulslike genre are a perfect match. The Ghostrunner studio nails a dynamic blend of steel, gunpowder and magic, with punishing, wildly original bosses and stunning art direction. Only its frustrating platforming and some technical rough edges hold it back.

Valor Mortis finally brings the Napoleonic era to center stage and, building on One More Level’s first-person expertise, succeeds as an action game thanks to satisfying parries, inspired bosses, fun gunplay and a proactive story that, carried by Vincent Cassel’s voice, guides the player to a finale packed with revelations. As a soulslike, however, it lacks the necessary bite, with ever-present lan

Valor Mortis attempts to carve out a place for itself in an increasingly competitive genre thanks to an unusual setting and a combat system that effectively alternates between melee weapons, firearms, and supernatural powers. The idea of blending Napoleonic aesthetics with horror elements is undoubtedly intriguing and helps give the project an identity of its own. However, some concerns remain reg

critic.quote: Minecraft Dungeons 2 is a brilliant sequel. It offers exactly what you want from the franchise and much more! The world is a joy to explore, and I love the new monsters and weird setting. It is fantastic with friends and great when playing alone. It captures every Minecraft vibe while remaining true to what we all love.

Minecraft Dungeons II takes everything that felt aimless about the original and brings it into focus. The combat is simple and the story is forgettable, but a steady drip of loot and satisfying buildcrafting make for a sticky, stay-up-too-late loop. Add clean performance and some of the most flexible co-op around, and you've got an accessible looter that works as well for Diablo vets as it does fo
Minecraft Dungeons II is a perfectly tuned sequel, taking everything that the first game got right, and expanding, revising and improving on it.

Minecraft Dungeons II builds on the original with deeper gameplay and more fleshed-out RPG elements. It may not be the ultimate dungeon crawler, but it delivers plenty of fun for all kinds of players, whether you play solo or with friends.
Minecraft Dungeons 2 improves upon the original in every way; it is a lightweight ARPG that is highly recommended for co-op play with the youngest members of the family.

Minecraft Dungeons 2's biggest weaknesses now lie in an unstable online component, which is a major problem for a game like this. I want to be able to join my friends online without worrying about constant rubber-banding or random disconnects. Or if I've had enough of dealing with these problems, I'd like to at least take my character off the online grid entirely without having to start over. I ha

s.desc:
​​​​​《星球大战：银河赛车手™》是一款以竞速为核心的惊险赛车游戏，重新定义了赛车游戏的概念，以星球大战™星系的法外之地外环星域为游戏背景。
帝国对银河系的统治终于瓦解，对速度的迷恋随之诞生。在新共和国艰难重建之际，赌博、娱乐和荣耀催生了一个日渐壮大的地下世界。
在这种混乱局面中，银河联赛诞生了：这是一个未经官方认可的赛车联盟，由各大财团赞助飞行员。短短几秒钟就能决定你会赚得盆满钵满，还是输得倾家荡产，只有勇敢者才能生存。
没有原力，没有预言，只有技巧、策略和崛起的意志。
参加惊险竞速
驾驶陆行艇、飞行摩托、滑橇艇和飞梭赛车，在各种赛道上猛烈撞击、左冲右突、终结对手。风险越大，回报就越高。
在危险的地下运动中生存下来
加入银河联赛——一个诞生于法外之地外环星域的非官方赛车联盟。化身为孤胆飞行员幽影，追逐复仇与荣耀。
打造并个性化你的飞行器
驾驶不同类型的反重力飞行器，每种飞行器都有其独特的物理特性和玩法。打造一款能够展现你个人风格并提供竞争优势的飞行器。
在多种游戏模式中与对手展开激战
在剧情驱动的战役中独自驰骋，体验不断变化的联盟关系；或者勇敢地参与策略性的 PvP 复仇之战，一路建立声望。
提升等级，赢取奖励
在激烈的竞争和不断升级的挑战中证明自己。你的每一个选择都将影响你在银河联赛中的地位和前景。

The arcade-style action is a pure delight, and the run-based nature of the campaign gives it a ton of replay value, even if you don 't intend to dip your toes into the multiplayer. If you 're looking for a n
The best Star Wars racing game ever made, which nails the high-speed fantasy while delivering depth, flexibility, and a surprisingly great campaign.

Star Wars Galactic Racer combines exhilarating speed, spectacular collisions and vehicles with distinctly different handling. Its extensive customization and near-roguelite campaign bring real depth to the racing, making every risk matter. Strong visuals and sound create a particularly convincing sense of immersion in the Star Wars universe. However, repetitive environments, on-foot sections that

Overall this is a racing game that’s brutal, so so fast and full of risk and reward at every deadly turn. It fits well in the Star Wars universe and sets out a stall for a whole new resurgence in sci-fi based landspeeder racing.

s.desc:
传奇制作人 “吹哥” Jonathan Blow（代表作：《时空幻境》《见证者》）携新作《沉星之序》重磅归来。这款宏大的冒险游戏内含 1000 多个手工设计的谜题，旨在考验你的智慧极限。你将踏入充满奇异魔法、危险机关与凶残怪物的异界，探索四个机制迥异、角色鲜明、故事独立的平行世界，最终见证它们彼此交汇碰撞的壮丽景象。随着世界融合、角色相遇，谜题系统也将相互交织，催生出意想不到的全新玩法。按自己的节奏自由探索，随时重返各个世界与挑战。解锁独特的可操作角色，掌握不断演变的游戏机制，逐步剥开这片广阔互联世界的深层秘密。融合探索、叙事与持续蜕变的机制，《沉星之序》将为你呈现一场前所未有、充满生命力的谜境之旅。
数千谜题，交织成篇
踏上这场创意十足的谜题冒险，体验数十种游戏机制与数百小时的独特玩法。每一个谜题都承前启后，引入全新机制，回报你的好奇心与坚持。
自由探索，随心漫游
探索四个庞大而神秘的世界，每个世界都有专属的角色、规则、险境与待发掘的秘密。来去随心，按自己的节奏应对眼前的一切谜题。
化身风格迥异的英雄
女王、盗贼、战士、巫师、乃至一艘会说话的小船……都将是这段传奇的英雄。每位角色都拥有相辅相成的能力与引人入胜的故事。
破解史诗级的谜团
随着角色相遇、世界相互碰撞，谜团逐渐揭晓。通过谜题与收集散落的笔记，你将一步步深入了解这个神秘国度。借助每一条线索、每一片拼图，最终揭开《沉星之序》的终极秘密。

critic.quote: Order of the Sinking Star is a demanding and inventive puzzle adventure that constantly finds new ways to challenge your understanding of its rules. Its four distinct worlds, character-driven limitations, and increasingly intertwined mechanics make solving puzzles deeply satisfying, even if prolonged roadblocks can sometimes become exhausting.

In a darkening world we have to be grateful for games that feel like idiosyncratic and mysterious opuses, because, while they’re never common, I sometimes worry they’re vanishing altogether. I’ve enjoyed every second of my time with Sinking Star, and will enjoy many hours more with it, and it will almost certainly be the most interesting new game to come out this year, GTA 6 included (you can use

There’s no doubt that Order of the Sinking Star is one of the best puzzle games out there. The continual evolution of mechanics sprawling across a puzzle-ridden overworld is vast and exciting, and it’s so cool to see it all come from the same core concept. I like that it tells different stories within this, which leads to the bigger mystery of where we are to begin with. Sometimes it can feel a li

Order of the Sinking Star hands you more than a thousand handcrafted puzzles and no tutorials, and that trust makes it special. Intuitive character abilities, four distinct worlds, and a shared Overworld give every solution a sense of ownership, while undo and restart keep experimentation painless. The same philosophy backfires when progress stalls with no sign of what you missed, and the scale we

Order of the Sinking Star is one of the most fascinating games we’ve played all year. It’s simple but challenging, always keeping the puzzles compelling while implementing new or adaptive mechanics throughout. It does suffer from story woes, and some of the puzzles can be frustrating at times, but still, Order of the Sinking Star remains something for the mind. It’s brilliantly put together, takin

Order of the Sinking Star demands a lot from its players, but rewards them with plenty of variety through four distinct directions, each with its own mechanics, style and story. The lack of hints and increasing difficulty can be frustrating, especially for casual puzzlers, but the way the different systems come together in the Gold Rooms creates satisfying aha-moments. critic.quote: Bluey’s Happy Snap captures the heart of the TV show and puts it into video game form. The game’s graphics let you see the world of Bluey as never before, and the fun you can have taking photos, finding secrets and completing your scrapbook is just the sweetest. It’s a real joy to play with your kid, or just let them have a go at it and help out when needed.

Overall, Bluey’s Happy Snaps does exactly what it sets out to do. It takes players on a journey into Bluey’s world, bringing everything to life in style. The locations, characters, and collectibles add to an interactive and enjoyable experience that truly shines.

Bluey's Happy Snaps is a family fun filled experience aimed at empowering kids to own their game time. It feels like a genuine Bluey episode that immerses players into the whacky adventures of the Heeler family, whilst providing easy controls and mechanics kids will love. Although replayability is dictated by how kids wish to tackle post game content, Happy Snaps will keep them smiling from play o

Bluey’s Happy Snaps is quite clearly built with a younger audience in mind, but don’t let that fool you into thinking it’s little more than a lazy cash-in on a popular franchise. There’s a notable level of care taken in bringing Bluey’s world to life here, and with plenty of things to snap and activities to try, Bluey’s Happy Snaps is a wonderfully fun time for kids and their parents alike.
Bluey's Happy Snaps' photography theme justifies another virtual romp through Bluey's world, though it can't quite escape feeling like a tablet game blown up for consoles.
Snafus aside, Bluey's Happy Snaps is an evergreen recommendation for hardcore fans of the show. If you're diving in for the first time, there are better ways to get acclimated.

critic.quote: Transport Fever 3 makes building a transport empire deeply rewarding, pairing intuitive tools with engaging logistical challenges. Its charming historical campaign, highly replayable sandbox and excellent performance make it a standout transport management game. Minor interface shortcomings do little to diminish an experience that kept us happily expanding our network after 30 hours.

While its performance and ease of use leave something to be desired, Transport Fever 3 is a wonderfully satisfying tycoon sim that excels at creating an organic flow, with strong macro- and micromanagement systems that let you go as deep as you want and play for as long as you want. [Issue#375, p.55]

Rethinking and centralizing operations is an integral part of Transport Fever 3: tasks initially handled by three small stations will eventually need to be routed through a single, massive terminal—a process that requires meticulous track planning as the lines increasingly crisscross one another. However, you are also free to scar the landscape with hundreds of different railway lines, turning the

Transport Fever 3 is certainly a great option for anyone who loves logistics-heavy games, management titles and transport tycoons. It’s one of the best in the genre, and it continues to iterate on the previous titles, while adding some much-needed improvements. That being said, it’s not perfect. It certainly requires a beefy computer for you to enjoy it with all the bells and whistles, and playing

Transport Fever 3 follows the spirit and fun of the original Transport Tycoon from the nineties, with a polished graphical system, much more information to analyze, and the challenging difficulty that makes it so entertaining. Watching cities grow thanks to your transportation network is just as rewarding as watching your company’s bank account grow, allowing you to purchase ships and airports. If

While Transport Fever 3 might feel familiar to OG fans of the series, it brings much deeper mechanics and a larger vehicle roster which makes it Urban Games’ most polished transport strategy game yet.

s.desc:
西蒙·奥德尔被唤回圣阿米莉亚岛，只求能“让一切重回正轨”。眼前的小镇静立于浓雾之下，看似荒废，实则异动暗生。
西蒙试图理解自己与这片土地及其居民的联系。随着调查步步深入，过去的记忆残片逐渐浮出水面。
游戏全程采用第一人称视角，西蒙必须凭借有限的武器和工具完成探索，在危险逼近时顺利脱身，活到最后。工具中有一台 CRTV 便携电视，能够接收到某些不稳定信号。逃生过程惊险刺激，战斗体验极尽疯狂。叙事驱动的谜题下，藏着呼之欲出的真相。
《SILENT HILL: Townfall》是一款完整独立的心理恐怖游戏。玩家将深入 1996 年的苏格兰，切身感受扑面而来的冷寂氛围。
探索 1996 年的圣阿米莉亚
雾气弥漫的街道串起遗落的街区，每个被忘却的角落都通过独特的氛围与历史诉说着自己的故事。现实与幻象在此悄然交织，吸引着玩家一步步迈入圣阿米莉亚，一个真实到仿佛触手可及的神秘世界。
新篇故事，一眼难忘
《SILENT HILL: Townfall》的舞台坐落在苏格兰雾气笼罩的街道景致之间，一段独一无二、扣人心弦的故事就此启幕。“恐怖”之外，更关乎“自省”、“失去”和“后果”。
惧意于细微处滋生——总有一些瞬间寂静到让人心慌，西蒙的过去投下挥之不去的阴影，愈来愈长。
前行战斗，策略为先
在激烈缠斗中利用近战武器攻击、格挡，或是保持距离，靠枪械保命。分析手头工具和周边环境，随机应变，巧妙处理每场遭遇战。
叙事谜题，CRTV 引导
《寂静岭》系列中标志性的收音机重磅回归，只是这次的形态是 CRTV，一款便携电视设备。附近潜伏的威胁、可供收集的故事片段以及神秘线索，正通过断断续续的模拟信号飘荡而来。只需适当调谐 CRTV，就能统统捕捉到。
第一人称，沉浸体验
这是首款采用第一人称视角的《寂静岭》系列完整作品，玩家将代入主角西蒙·奥德尔，亲身探索这座浓雾笼罩的小镇，体会每个令人隐隐不安的细节。
多重结局，任君体验
行动决定着剧情的走向，当故事画上句点，情感的余波仍久久不能散去。
声效加音乐，共同营造紧张感
伴着一声声吱呀、信号音与尖叫，危险逐渐逼近耳畔，而富有创意的音效设计则营造出丰富而令人毛骨悚然的声景。Pilotpriest 创作的全动态配乐会随着玩家和敌人的行动而层层铺陈。

critic.quote: Silent Hill: Townfall is a stunning spin-off for the series, taking to a new setting and telling its own unique story, expanding your ideas of what exactly a Silent Hill experience can be. With a semi-open world littered with tense corners to explore, creative puzzles to unravel and heaps of analogue nostalgia – Townfall never outstays its welcome, and we are so ready to dive in again.
Navigating this world, especially while being pursued, amplifies the sense of confusion and claustrophobia that are crucial to the subgenre of psychological survival horror.

Silent Hill: Townfall is a genuinely frightening experience, with an oppressive atmosphere, excellent sound design and clever analogue-driven puzzles. However, it often moves away from Silent Hill’s psychological horror DNA, leaning more towards experiences like Alien Isolation. Finally, despite a less memorable bestiary, Townfall remains a smart, inventive and disturbing horror game with a strong

Silent Hill: Townfall truly honours the series while offering a different, often thoughtful take on it. And when its direction, silences, music and sudden surges of tension come together, it feels profoundly like Silent Hill… while retaining an identity of its own. The way the story unfolds, the gradual understanding of what brought about Saint Amelia’s downfall and the guilt carried by both the p

All in all, despite its frustrating quirks and mechanics, Silent Hill: Townfall’s new additions to the franchise feel refreshing while still honoring the series’ core strengths. While it may not be the absolute peak of the franchise, Silent Hill: Townfall is easy to recommend to series fans—especially those who don’t mind a heavier focus on stealth in their survival horror.

Ultimately, Silent Hill: Townfall is an interesting experiment: both a masterclass in atmospheric dread and environmental puzzle design that gets bogged down by an exhausting, uneven, frustrating gameplay loop. critic.quote: A cracking rogue-like shooter that builds on the solid foundation of the previous game, Neon Abyss 2 offers countless hours of frantic fun.

Neon Abyss 2 is a solid addition to today's indie roguelike scene. It manages to stand out thanks to its fun and frantic combat, exploration that encourages experimenting with different builds using randomly discovered items, and challenging enemy design. While its overall structure doesn't feel particularly innovative and its guidance can sometimes be unclear, it's still an experience well worth

Overall, I really enjoyed my time with Neon Abyss 2. It’s fun, easy to pick up and play, has a ton of progression systems to keep you hooked, and customization to make runs as easy or hard as you want. I would’ve loved more opportunities to create proper builds rather than having mostly incremental upgrades each run, which could have added an extra layer of complexity that the best-in-class games

For better or for worse, Neon Abyss 2 feels very much like more Neon Abyss. But some meaningful changes in progression and permanent upgrades, along with a whole new way to play, make this zany roguelike just as gloriously addictive as the first game ever was.

Neon Abyss 2 is a beautiful sequel, with bolder visuals, flashier weapons and more game-breaking strategies. Unfortunately, the difficulty drops fast once you find the right item combination. The flashy gameplay is fun, but finding a game-breaking strategy happens a bit too quickly. The light show it creates is a joy to behold, yet I couldn’t shake the feeling that I, not the bosses, was the overp

s.desc:
若已拥有《Way of the Hunter》，你可在购买此产品时享受10%优惠。
《Way of the Hunter 2》围绕活生生的生态系统、先进的动物行为系统与三个各有特色的狩猎区域为核心，为玩家带来更具深度、更有动感的狩猎体验。你可在广阔的北美洲荒野追踪猎物，在非洲猎场直面凶险的野生动物，也可在落基山脉地区随意探索——赫斯-亨特总部狩猎屋就在此处；这是一个可扩建的狩猎中心，拥有额外房间、展示空间与战利品支架，可供你展示自己从各个猎场获得的优质战利品。
动物将以极其自然的方式做出行动，并对周边环境做出反应。仔细研究动物痕迹、移动方式与栖息地状况，不会草率开枪的猎人，将受到这个系统的着重奖励。玩家也可随意行走、探索荒野，享受说走就走的狩猎乐趣，在猎犬的陪伴下体验自然之美。本作在前作基础上进扩展内容，进一步优化了真实性、上手难易度与玩家自由度，同时也保留了系列作品经过精心设计的游戏节奏与拟真度。
前往地处北美洲与非洲的猎场，在丰富的荒野环境中享受狩猎乐趣。追踪并展示驼鹿、马鹿、熊、野牛等大型动物，同时也有大量小型动物与鸟类等待着你。在非洲，你将直面世界上最凶悍的野生动物，包括体型巨大的河马、势如奔雷的水牛、暗中潜伏的狮子，和行踪诡秘的尼罗鳄。
作为一位适应力极强的猎人，你一心想要闯出一番名声。被赫斯-亨特招募后，你的工作便是帮助各地居民，与赫斯-亨特的新同事通力协作，保护各地的生态系统。在这个过程中，你将面临各种独特挑战，踏遍三个风景绝美的狩猎区域。前往新劳伦西亚，在技术高超的训犬师与前任管理员的帮助下，调查当地驼鹿种群数量异常背后的原因。
在基里玛雅保护区帮助有名的野生动物园向导，与古怪的箭术专家共同训练，并找出一位传奇女猎手的踪迹，帮助维持当地生态系统的平衡。与此同时，在落基山脉深处，一位上了年纪却不失风趣的爱尔兰木匠正等着帮你把辛苦赚来的钞票变成狩猎屋扩建项目，为你献上额外房间与战利品展示空间——不仅如此，他还会给你讲述不少关于蘑菇的故事，还有本地传说哦！
FEATURES:
• 猎犬：带上你忠诚的狩猎伙伴，让它在你狩猎追踪猎物时为你保驾护航。它能搜寻动物踪迹、定位血迹，还能追踪受伤的猎物。只要坚持训练和历练，你的猎犬就会不断成长精进。
• 射击回放：我们升级后的子弹视角能让你精准剖析每一次射击的全过程。分析弹道轨迹、弹头速度、射击角度、着弹点等关键数据——助你掌握技巧，实现百发百中的完美射击。
• 高科技装备：各种先进装备帮你磨砺本能；热成像夜视仪为你带来更具沉浸感的狩猎体验；各种先进的保护区监控措施帮你更好地管理各个栖息地。
• 赫斯-亨特总部：一个位于落基山脉的小型中心地图。在这里，你可以放松精神，也可以走进荒野随意探索。扩建狩猎屋，让它随着你的狩猎冒险不断成长，在里面装满你从各个地区收集的最爱战利品！
• 来自 10 多家真实品牌合作伙伴的装备，涵盖从猎枪到高科技设备，带来极具沉浸感的逼真狩猎体验。
• 在线上合作多人游戏中，与他人共同体验荒野的乐趣。一同狩猎、探索广大的保护区，在野外世界共享难忘时光。

critic.quote: As a trip through six decades of music, the song selection choice is mostly very strong, with fun new dances for everyone – and the surprise, welcome return of fan-favourite stop-motion hero Lizzy in Celebration. This year’s Just Dance is a worthy entry for new and returning players alike.
Just Dance: Decades of Hits is a wonderfully entertaining game, and the only thing more fun than playing it is watching someone else dance

A Just Dance that changes its name more than its formula. While the new Adventure Mode adds little to the experience, the game is still the perfect excuse to get everyone off the couch and onto the dance floor.

Just Dance: Decades of Hits is one of the strongest entries in the series in recent years, offering a diverse tracklist, colorful choreography, and a fun Adventure Mode. The return of multiple Dancer Cards is a welcome improvement, especially for multiplayer fans. However, inaccurate Joy-Con tracking, limited camera controller support, and a lack of variety in Adventure Mode hold it back slightly.

Just Dance: Decades of Hits works where it matters. At the end of the day it’s a fun workout game that allows for a lot of flexibility when it comes to the song choice. It has an annoying but ultimately unobtrusive way of asking you to spend more money, but if you find the main game is worth it, who's to say the extras aren’t worth it to you, too?

Nomura’s legacy rolls out the red carpet for Nintendo fans, with everything a native Switch 2 release entails: the unmatched appeal of handheld play, the inevitable performance and frame rate scrutiny, and the ultimate runway setting up Kingdom Hearts 4.

Kingdom Hearts Collection [I–III] is the definitive collection of the series, offering everything fans need to know to prepare for the fourth numbered entry. A highlight is the Switch 2 version, which finally allows console owners to run the games natively and with good performance.

Overall, Kingdom Hearts Collection 1-3 on Switch 2 is a fantastic package that is so close to being completely on par with the Integrum Masterpiece release. Kingdom Hearts 3 and A Fragmentary Passage’s framerate issues are the only things stopping it from definitively being my new favourite way to play, but the ability to go portable is worth those minor issues. Whether you’re a complete newcomer

Kingdom Hearts Collection I-III offers an excellent way to experience nearly the entire series on Nintendo Switch 2, delivering strong performance across most of its titles and the considerable appeal of playing these adventures in handheld mode. Although Kingdom Hearts III and Kingdom Hearts 0.2 suffer from some technical issues, the collection remains a fantastic package for both newcomers and l

Kingdom Hearts Collection [I～III] is the best way to play the whole saga, in order. The classics show their age and Kingdom Hearts III hovers between 40 and 50 FPS, but Switch 2 still runs the collection well.

s.desc:

《深岩银河：幸存者》是一款单人类幸存者游戏。利用深岩银河集团的各式武器，在成群的致命异虫的攻势下，不断挖掘财宝、解锁强力升级，并活着逃出生天。以一矮人之力，对抗整个霍克斯星球！
结合挖矿的子弹狂飙体验
消灭异虫、升级装备，一往无前地深入霍克斯的致命洞穴。收集并搭建各类威力惊人的武器，在疾风骤雨般的战斗中扫射一波接一波的外星怪物，深入挖掘潜藏在矿洞岩体之中的各类宝矿。作为类幸存者游戏，你完全不用担心应该盯着岩体挖矿，还是盯着虫群射击——在你仓皇逃窜或挖到手软的同时，武器将自动朝着对的方向喷吐弹幕。
正如《深岩银河》中一样，游戏的洞穴和敌人波次均由程序生成，每个任务都独一无二，颇具趣味。
完成任务，逐渐变强
向深处进发，矿工！一旦离开空投舱，迈入令人压抑的黑暗，你便是孤军奋战。在逐渐凶猛的异虫攻势下，完成集团下发的任务，并及时返回空降舱，由此反复。一边逐渐探索星球深处，一边不断提升实力，顽强存活至任务结束，带着沉甸甸的战利品满载而归。
以全新视角探索深岩宇宙
以崭新的单人游戏体验，探索深受数百万玩家喜爱的深岩银河宇宙！在俯视角下体验各个任务，探索你从未见过的霍克斯洞穴。灰胡子老手想必能认出许多来自《深岩银河》的内容，而如果你是刚加入的绿胡子菜鸟，我们向你致以诚挚的欢迎！很高兴你选择加入我们。你会喜欢这里的——毕竟这可是管理层的要求。
挖到手软，赚到盆满！

critic.quote: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is the most genuine threat to Vampire Survivor's rule yet.
Vampire Survivors is no longer the king of the genre.

Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor doesn’t necessarily revolutionize its genre, but it doesn’t need to. With this entry in the action roguelike autoshooter genre, Funday Games has created a delightfully enjoyable game that will keep you coming back for more.

Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is more than just another Vampire Survivors clone—it’s a faithful spin on the co-op classic that carries over its humor, class personality, and suffocating cave atmosphere. The lack of camaraderie stings, and the grind and balance issues get rough in the endgame, but the core loop of digging, shooting, and upgrading never stops being fun. For fans of either genre, it’s
A fine addition to a young genre, Survivor adds smart twists, most notably its level-based structure; however, unlike the mainline Deep Rock Galactic, it’s single-player only.

Auto Shooter, set in the proven Dwarven Universe, already offers a complete package, with hordes of creatures and rare resources to discover underground. However, the difficulty level is high, and the repetition of biomes and missions unnecessarily and artificially extends the game's scope.

s.desc:
在一处神秘地下基地的深处，一场调查不明来源异动的任务逐渐演变为穿越破败废弃世界的惊魂之旅。扮演年轻的战斗技术员 Cel，直面游荡于此的恐怖怪物，同时揭开设施荒废区域的真相。
踏入深渊
踏入庞大建筑群的大厅，破损的机械从深处传来低语，眼前的一切早已脱离人类认知的范畴。
为生存而战
面对扭曲的恐怖造物，你在力量上被完全碾压。必须升级装备、随机应变，在被困设施带来的致命压力下突破极限，才能在绝境中求得一线生机。
探索失落路径
利用扫描仪与沿途解锁的工具，在分支路线中穿梭并发现隐藏区域。随着能力提升，曾被封印的通道将逐一开启 —— 你得以重返被遗忘的走廊，探寻尘封已久的秘密。
Section 9 匠心之作
《End of Abyss》由瑞典马尔默的小型团队精心打造，核心开发者曾参与多款爆款游戏制作，为玩家带来极具沉浸感的专注体验。

critic.quote: End of Abyss is the surprise hit of year, with its forebodingly atmospheric Facility, unsettling enemy design, and well executed minimalist philosophy, it brilliantly combines its multiple genres to create a distilled and engaging survival horror experience.

We all know perfectly well that we’re in the middle of one of the most intense release periods in recent years. Practically everywhere you look, there’s a major game waiting for you, so the idea of jumping into something you weren’t expecting and that seemingly came out of nowhere can be quite difficult. That’s precisely where End of Abyss comes in. It’s an extremely good game in almost everything

End of Abyss is easily one of the better Metroidvanias to release this year. Its exceptional map design and rewarding character progression draw you in almost instantly, while the challenging monstrosities make combat fun to master. However, the game's strengths can also become a source of frustration. Its heavy reliance on Metroidvania elements, such as constantly requiring a key or specific item

End of Abyss is an atmospheric and unsettling sci-fi adventure that excels through exploration, environmental mystery, and a compelling sense of discovery. Its satisfying investigation mechanics and memorable boss encounters keep the descent engaging, though overly durable enemies, unclear weapon balance, and repetitive combat prevent it from reaching its full potential.

End of Abyss is an adventure that is both difficult and satisfying, combining stunning graphics with some rather unpleasant visuals and offering a carefully designed exploration facility. Every area is packed full of secrets to discover, unique enemies to fight, and tough bosses to overcome. With a mysterious story to solve, the game stands out in a highly competitive field and offers an experienc
Contrary to its fetchingly diminutive presentation, End of Abyss might be just too big for its own good.

As for those 0/10 reviews, I think some people just don’t get what this game is going for, or aren’t used to similar games but a 0/10? Come on.

The controls might feel a bit tricky at first, but after 15 minutes, everything **** th

s.desc:
《THUNDERCADE》是SETA于1987年推出的一款射击游戏。
作为特种部队的一员，玩家需驾驶一辆配备机枪的高速摩托车，突袭敌方据点。
摧毁建筑物等设施后，会出现以配备枪管的边车形式呈现的强化道具。边车种类繁多，有的射程更远，有的只能向侧面射击，请根据不同情况选择合适的边车！
《Arcade Archives》系列秉承忠实复刻经典街机游戏的理念开发，并搭载了难度与画面设置、回溯功能、连发模式及多存档位等便捷特性。玩家还可通过在线排行榜与全球玩家竞逐最高分数。
《Arcade Archives 2》在系列原有的“ORIGINAL MODE”、“HI SCORE MODE”、“CARAVAN MODE”基础上，新增“TIME ATTACK MODE”模式。在“TIME ATTACK MODE”中，玩家将不计分数全力竞速通关。新增的VRR（可变刷新率）支持功能，更能还原接近街机原版的流畅体验。
请尽情享受这些标志性的街机游戏吧！它们定义了一个时代，尽在“Arcade Archives”系列！
*本商品仅限PlayStation🄬5游玩。
除本商品外，还有PlayStation🄬4的《Arcade Archives THUNDERCADE》。本商品的保存数据与PlayStation🄬4的《Arcade Archives THUNDERCADE》不兼容，且与追加内容也不兼容。请注意不要购买重复商品或购买错误商品。
*如果您已经购买了 PlayStation🄬4《Arcade Archives THUNDERCADE》，您将能够通过“游戏所有者折扣”购买 PlayStation🄬5《Arcade Archives 2 THUNDERCADE》。
*选项菜单和手册有日语，英语，法语，德语，意大利语和西班牙语。

在《Seafarer: The Ship Sim》的大海中扬帆启航，打造您的生涯。独自一人或在多人模式中组成最多4名玩家的船队操纵各种各样的船只、探索北欧风的广阔开放世界，并接下各式各样的海上工作，像是海运和搜救任务、灭火、巡逻，以及各种超乎预料的事件。在多人模式中，扮演船员分工进行船上作业、在任务中互相协助，攻克海上生活的各项挑战。
化身壮志凌云的船长展开您的生涯，在不同港口和派系中树立您的名声。完成任务、解锁新的商机、扩展船队，并在海上开创自己的道路。无论您是要在港口间运送大宗商品和液化天然气集装箱等各式货物、回应海潮看守员的求救信号、利用无人机侦查大海，或纯粹享受海浪的起伏，每次航行都有新的事物可探索。
跟随Teddy的视角展开剧情模式，这名经验丰富的船长有一段不幸的过去。随着阴谋、海盗行为和昔日秘密的曝光，您将身陷一段关于内疚、信任和赎罪的海上悬疑故事之中。
有易上手的船只操作、多种船上互动、动态天气、塑造航向的洋流，以及拜虚幻引擎5与NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0所赐的惊人海浪，《Seafarer: The Ship Sim》在每次航行中都能带来海上生活的自由、氛围和冒险。
独自一人或在多人模式中组成最多4名玩家的船队
指挥多样的船队，包括小船、货船和油轮
通过任务、名声和船队进度打造您的生涯
更改名称、颜色、旗帜和标志，自定义您的船只
体验关于谜团、阴谋和赎罪的剧情模式
接下运货、营救、灭火和巡逻的任务
使用起重机、水炮、无人机和搜救装备等互动工具
应对动态事件、无线电呼叫、每日挑战、洋流和不断变化的天气
享受虚幻引擎5和NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0带来的身历其境海洋视觉效果

s.desc:
《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2》是复古第一人称射击游戏《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun》的快节奏凶残续作。
故事紧接着《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun》的结尾展开，你在分支结构的单人战役中前往新的地点履行职责，体验黑暗残酷的 Warhammer 40,000 宇宙与快节奏第一人称射击游戏的完美融合。
扮演全新的冠军
两个可玩角色可供选择，各自拥有独特的能力、武器和玩法。
威势赫赫的肃卫老兵马鲁姆·凯多因净化异端而闻名，是一股主宰战斗的不屈之力。轻灵敏捷的战斗修女奈拉·维拉思则擅长快速掌控战场，所到之处，敌人尽皆焚为灰烬。
探索全新的世界
前往从未踏足的世界，消灭潜伏当地的敌人。从高耸入云的巢都到寸步难行的丛林沼泽，你需要克服各种环境中的险恶挑战来完成肩负的使命。
血腥刺激的战斗
在《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun》的劲爆战斗的基础上再度升级，让你配备星际战士五花八门的危险武器，一往无前地投入荣耀的战斗之中。挥舞致命的链锯剑将敌人大卸八块，或是端起霰弹枪将其轰成血肉模糊的残渣！
前所未有的敌人
你的武器库不断提升，敌人也不甘示弱！凶残的放血者骑在恶魔巨兽上冲入战场，化身为近乎势不可挡的嗜血怪物！
特色
两个可玩角色：扮演威势赫赫的马鲁姆·凯多或久经沙场的奈拉·维拉思，两个角色玩法各异。
炸裂的第一人称射击玩法：在令人血脉偾张的战斗中大开杀戒。
分支结构战役：通过战役选择自己的路线，每个分支包含独特的关卡。
全新敌人：迎战来自不同派系的前所未见的敌人。
全新武器：使用毁灭性的武器碾碎无穷无尽的异端敌潮。
全新地点：探索多个新世界和生态环境。
寻路向导：在战场上轻松穿行，始终处于战斗中心。
还有更多精彩内容！

critic.quote: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 serves as an ideal sequel to an already stellar game by refining the things that matter, dropping the things that don’t, and focusing on vastly expanding the blisteringly fast-paced, brutal action.

If you want something you can jump into for a quick gameplay session and have an incredible time blasting through colorful stages and fiendish foes, look no further. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 delivers fast-paced, exhilarating action that’ll get your heart pumping and your feet stomping. This game gives you that satisfying hit of nostalgia, but with a modern twist that feels charming and unique.

Warhammer 40K: Boltgun 2 is bigger and more ambitious than the 2023 original, with a new character, more enemies, weapons and places to go in the non-linear campaign. It remains a highly effective homage to classic boomer shooters and Warhammer 40,000. However, while the battles are bigger and more chaotic, there aren’t many changes of pace and the relentless action becomes a bit repetitive if pla

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is certainly a good shooter that improves upon its predecessor in certain areas—primarily level design and enemy variety. However, much like the original, it suffers from flaws that keep it from being anything more than just a good game, preventing it from ever reaching greatness.

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 carries the torch of the original, amplifying its exhilarating gameplay with a compelling new character, detailed enemy and world designs, and level branches that offer a surprising touch of complexity in their objectives. Technical hiccups can lead to moments of frustration that may stunt progress or the flow of action in a few ways. However, the snappy pacing helps ke

A nurgling genocide of a sequel that directly addresses almost everything that held the first game back, while still finding time to squeeze in a generous dollop of additional creativity. The best ‘90s FPS you never played.

s.desc:
MXGP 官方授权的真实呈现：
扮演您最喜爱的车手，在 MXGP 和 MX2 组别的全部 19 条本赛季官方赛道上尽情驰骋。每一个弯道、每一次飞跃以及赛道的每一个路段，都以无与伦比的还原度进行了重新制作，带您身临其境地融入官方赛季的核心。
画面革命：
MXGP 系列首次凭借全新的 Unreal Engine 5（虚幻引擎 5）全力加速。其结果如何？一场重新定义该类型游戏标准的壮丽画面革命。光影效果、材质纹理和环境细节将令您叹为观止。比以往任何时候都更加流畅、自然的选手动作，将让您感觉自己仿佛正亲自跨骑在摩托车上。
赛道赋予生命：掌控动态地形形变
这是彻底改变游戏规则的全新核心特色！有史以来第一次，地面会对每一次车轮的驶过做出实时做出反应。压出深车辙、开辟全新的行车路线并征服它们。赛道在不断变化，由于其对物理效果的影响是真实存在的，您必须不断调整自己以适应多变的轨迹，这将极大地考验您的天赋和适应能力。
铸就你传奇的游戏模式：
在 Compound（自由练习场）中自由磨练您的压车（scrubs）和甩尾（whips）技巧，或者在 Time Trial（时光挑战赛）中追求极限单圈速度。
渴望竞争？在 Quick Race（快速随机赛）中，与 20 名凶悍的车手同场竞技，抢占杆位（holeshot），并在或长或短的单局比赛中奋力捍卫自己的名次。在 Championship（锦标赛）模式中，圆梦您的理想赛季并夺取红盘（red plate）。
最后，当 Online Multiplayer（多人在线联机）的起跑门落下时，通过全球排行榜向世界展示谁才是这个星球上最顶尖的车手。

critic.quote:
MXGP 26 is one of those games that are extremely appealing for fans of the genre, and even someone who’s not into MXGP will find plenty to love here. The championship mode is the highlight, and then you also have time trials, grand prix and other modes to keep you company for a few dozen hours. Plus, there’s also a multiplayer which, when works well, is extremely fun and enjoyable.
The lack of ch

MXGP 26 feels like it came straight out of 2006, and I mean that in the most positive way possible. It’s missing a few pieces and there are some rough edges to iron out, but the foundations are all there and they work remarkably well. If your goal is to kick up some dirt and soar over jumps, Artefacts Studio’s game won’t disappoint. If you’re looking for a more detailed and feature-rich experience

MXGP 26 is a fine, serviceable motocross sim that checks the necessary boxes for official licensing and baseline physics, but it doesn’t push the genre forward in any meaningful way. It works well as a reliable pick-up-and-play title for handheld devices like the Steam Deck provided you don’t mind squinting at the UI but racing veterans looking for a true next-gen leap may find it a bit too playin

There is just one music track on the main menu—nothing more—which is perfect for anyone wanting to play a podcast or their favorite playlist in the background; however, those looking to immerse themselves in the adventure have to settle for the roar of the exhaust and little else.

users.quote: This is the MXGP game we have been waiting for for so long. The track deformation is next level. MXGP26 is a solid game.

s.desc:
遭逢悲惨变故的阿尔弗雷德踏上了北上之路，去寻求救赎。在这款单人公路旅行冒险游戏中，你将前往风景名胜之地，用相机捕捉难忘的记忆，遇见形形色色的人物，还能结交一些新朋友。

展开剧情
经历一场细腻刻画、动人心弦的故事，体验破碎的梦想、失去和遗憾——以及勇气、希望和真挚的友谊。了解一路上邂逅的各种人物的生平、信仰和挣扎，感受著名配音演员的生动演绎。

踏上难忘的公路旅行
探索美丽的自然环境：幽深静谧的林中小径、烈日炙烤的沙漠荒原，等等。查看物体并与之交互，从而了解周边环境以及当地居民。

捕捉记忆
使用阿尔弗雷德的老伙计——快速成像相机拍照，记录旅程中的点点滴滴并破解环境小谜题。

回味真爱
化身阿尔弗雷德回顾与一生挚爱奥黛丽的相知相恋相守，体验跨越时间的真爱。原声音乐由Clark Aboud（代表作：《Slay the Spire》《Kind Words》）创作。

critic.quote: I was sold on Forever Ago from the trailer alone because I’m a sucker for these tear-jerking narrative experiences that happen to hit all the emotions. After being fully engrossed in Alfred's life, I know Third Shift has created something truly special. Forever Ago is an example of creative expression that the industry needs more of, and is definitely worth your time.

Forever Ago is an intimate and moving narrative experience that handles complex themes like aging and loss with rare delicacy. Although its measured pace requires some patience, Third Shift’s title possesses all the warmth needed to win over anyone looking for a profound and reflective story.
Forever Ago is a beautiful tale of loss, grief and growth, and Arthur's roadtrip reminds us all that you just can't plan life.

Forever Ago is a narrative experience that succeeds in how it handles its plot and prompts reflection on grief and the pain of loss. The gameplay could have explored the camera mechanics more, but the locations, memories, and people encountered along the journey offer moments of reflection and create a captivating experience.

Forever Ago is a celebration of life, a beautifully written road-trip on tragedy, love and healing. Despite its technical issues and lack of player agency, it's an example of how walking simulators create unique experiences.

Forever Ago is a moving narrative about love, loss, and rediscovery, carried by strong writing and a powerful soundtrack. While its minimal gameplay and rushed pacing hold it back, the emotional resonance makes it a memorable experience for the right audience.

users.author: iLurota
users.quote:
I feel like everything good about humanity was condensed into this masterpiece. Even though I'm still a young man in my late 20s, this story made me feel immense gratitude for the life I'm given and the journey that still awaits me, as well as for people in my life I get to create memories with, and the memories they've made as well.

Gameplay is mostly narrative-driven, but I've enjoyed every second of it - the story, the visuals, the music, and the characters grounded in their own authenticity

critic.quote: A great array of distinctive cars, mix of winding country roads and crowded urban highways, and modes that emphasize clean racing help this racer shine.

With Gear.Club Unlimited 3, nothing gets reinvented, but plenty gets refined. The addition of Japan, a tighter Career flow, Highway Mode, and deeper customization give the game more variety and confidence, while Switch 2 finally lets it run the way it should. It’s an accessible racer with enough depth for car fans and competitive players alike, and an easy entry point for families. Not groundbreak

Gear.Club Unlimited 3 brings licensed arcade racing to Nintendo Switch 2, offering an accessible experience across the scenic roads of Japan and France. While the visuals and club management mechanics shine, a lack of launch content and stripped-back multiplayer make it feel like a step backward from its predecessor. It is a solid choice for solo racers, though it still needs post-launch polish to

Gear.Club Unlimited 3 is a tough game to rate. At its core, the driving is sound, the graphics are decent, the game mechanics are interesting, and the career is meaty enough to bother. It even offers a 60 frames per second mode, something previous episodes did not – at least, on Nintendo consoles. On the other hand, it has various important flaws related to the overall racing, and the lack of onli

Gear.Club Unlimited 3 is a title with good intentions and a competent gameplay foundation. However, it accumulates too many technical issues, the driving feel and physics are poor, the AI does not behave well, and the absence of online multiplayer along with the very limited content weigh too heavily.
There are moments where Gear.Club Unlimited 3 nearly comes together, but when other games like JDM and Tokyo Xtreme Racer exist, it becomes clear just how much of a poor facsimile it is.

自由探索，无拘无束。

真实驾驶，沉浸体验。
感受灵敏的车辆操控、真实的换挡体验以及精心设计的驾驶机制，让每一段旅程都充满乐趣与成就感。
50项任务等待完成，无数道路等待探索，每一次驾驶都是提升技巧的新机会。
通过方向盘外设支持，将沉浸感提升到全新高度，让每次驾驶都拥有更精准的操控和更真实的体验！
学习规则，磨练车技，自由探索。

再次踏入Radius：这片超现实而危机四伏的区域与外界隔绝，遍布致命实体、不断变化的异常现象和珍贵神器。探索、搜刮、完成任务，并在每次远征中存活下来，设法返回。
搭载PS VR2特色功能的VR生存射击游戏回归
《Into the Radius 2》登陆PS VR2，带来沉浸式生存第一人称射击体验，并针对头显提供眼动追踪注视点渲染、控制器与头显专属触觉反馈、3D音效、PlayStation活动和奖杯等功能。
掌握逼真的武器
每把枪械均拥有逼真的细节与独特操控手感。逐件自定义经典与现代武器，组合枪管、枪托、护木、瞄具、弹匣和配件，打造适合自己玩法的配置。保持枪械清洁并妥善维护，否则它们可能在最关键时刻卡壳。
准备好装备
所有装备均可亲手操作。按自己的想法配置胸挂、护甲背心、背包、收纳袋和枪套。根据机动性、操控性、舒适度或生存需求调整配装，再用喷漆个性化装备，从简洁纯色到多层迷彩图案。
直面RADIUS的阴影
与聪明的Mimics战斗：它们会搜寻、包抄、寻找掩护，并对所见所闻作出反应。设法在Fragments、隐形Phantoms、Creeps及其他扭曲威胁中生存下来；每种敌人都有独特行为和危险。
在异常现象中求生
Radius充满致命异常现象：它们可能爆裂成弹片、释放电击、压制附近光源、附着在你身上后爆炸，或将你猛烈推开。除非佩戴特殊的抗扭曲头部装备，否则扭曲区域可在数秒内将你撕碎。
规划路线，留意周围环境，并适应不断变化的Tide周期，才能活着回来。

critic.quote: Into the Radius 2's early access launch provides a solid foundation that balances the horror and realism elements well. Unfortunately, it's let down by bugs and issues aplenty. A lack of content also makes this hard to currently recommend, even for diehard fans of the first game, unless you're investing to help CM Games hopefully make a better game than its predecessor.

s.desc:
现在预约《STRANGER THAN HEAVEN》，即可获得预购特典：游戏内武器“短刀·影切”。
包含内容
·武器“短刀·影切”
这是一个关于无处安身的男人们，为了寻找归宿而战斗了50年的故事。
1915年，旧金山。故事从一个少年在深夜的港口城市偷偷潜入一艘神秘的船开始。
少年名叫大东真。
他的父亲是美国人，母亲是日本人。
因自身亚洲人的样貌，大东遭到了严重的迫害，
如今父母双亡、孑然一身的他，决定前往母亲的故乡——日本。
虽然在美国无处立足，但日本一定会有自己的容身之处。
大东怀揣着这样的信念，只身一人登上了那艘船。在船上那场可谓命中注定的邂逅，彻底改变了他此后的人生轨迹。
在日本等待着大东的究竟是什么？在经历了漫长旅途之后，他最后的归宿又会是何处……
■五个时代、五座城市
故事的舞台，是以日本各个时代的真实城市为蓝本创造的“或许存在过的日本”。
1915年，坐拥世界最大规模铸造设备的钢铁厂所在地、大街小巷满是血气方刚的务工人员的福冈·小仓。
1929年，拥有日本最大的海军工厂、深受黑道势力影响的广岛·吴。
1943年，西日本最繁华的娱乐街区，世界局势紧张背景下的大阪·南区。
1951年，在战后成为了日本旅游景点代名词的静冈·热海。
以及1965年，至今仍是日本最繁华，也是最混乱的娱乐街区，东京·新宿。
■最自由、最本能、最极限的暴力
这是一个所有人都为了活下去而拼死挣扎的时代。
通过战斗系统，体验在这充斥着暴力的动荡年代，为了生存而展开的激烈搏斗。
化身大东，随心所欲地操纵左半身和右半身，身临其境地进行战斗。
用刺拳打出强力一击，或使用蓄力攻击将敌人击飞，趁敌人站立不稳之际将其摔倒在地，压在身下大揍特揍，暴力到近乎残忍地痛扁敌人。
不仅如此，还可以单手挡下敌人的攻击并立刻施以还击。通过观察敌人动作，自由自在地创造出决定性的攻击瞬间。
此外，还能强化并使用菜刀、锤子、日本刀等多种武器，在与各个时代的暴徒的对决中杀出一条血路。
■大东真，作为策划人的另一面
教导大东如何在日本生存下去的师父发掘出了大东的音乐天赋。此后，大东不仅亲自献唱，还开始以“策划人”的身份参与策划演出活动。
为了进一步扩大演出规模，大东在街头四处打听，寻找并签下优秀的歌手与乐手。
为寻找作曲灵感而前往街头，听取扫帚声、鼾声、蒸汽机车声、动物的叫声乃至战斗时对手发出的声音。把各种各样的声音纳入作曲的参考，将其排列组合，创作出属于自己的原创音乐。
通过确定曲目、乐队编排、成员分工来策划演出，精心设计灯光颜色等舞台效果，将演出呈现在观众面前。不断在各地举办演出、吸引观众，书写大东作为策划人的传奇故事。

critic.quote: Wandering Sword is a phenomenal 2.5D game that provides tons of unique mechanics to its gameplay. Paired with the equally beautiful soundtracks, Wandering Sword's tile-based combat and exploration feel incredible and mesmerizing. Though lacking a bit in several areas, particularly its stiff combat animations, this game is a great package for those who enjoy ancient Chinese-based martial arts exper

I loved every second of the 30+ hours I poured into Wandering Sword. In a year filled with so many critically acclaimed RPGs like Baldur’s Gate 3, Starfield, Final Fantasy XVI, and Sea of Stars, I could easily see a smaller, PC-only release like Wandering Sword getting lost in the shuffle. That would be an absolute tragedy, as Wandering Sword delivered one of the best gaming experiences I’ve had a

Wandering Sword is a journey into an ancient China to be explored from top to bottom, meeting wonderful characters and engaging in pitched battles in which tactics, party members and character build are crucial. Progression is quite fast-paced and debunks the cliché that would have Eastern games to be based on grinding. The main campaign is fairly linear, but there are enough side quests that prov

Wandering Sword offers an adventure through a Chinese-inspired land of mystical martial arts that is elevated by its aesthetics and setting while being backed up by an engaging tactical combat system. While it doesn’t do anything revolutionary, it will be worth the time invested for players attracted to the material.

In a time when absolutely massive blockbuster RPGs are sucking up all the oxygen in the room, Wandering Sword stands out as an amazing independent RPG that crushes every goal it sets out to achieve. While the RPG mechanics may feel like a crawl compared to similar RPGs, the world it presents players is rich and beautiful in every way. 预购任意版本的《Until Dawn 2》即可获得Dr. Hill的独家服装和游戏内收藏品，为您的游戏体验增添别样风格。
预购奖励包括¹：
• Dr. Hill -《Until Dawn》经典服装和摇头公仔游戏内收藏品
• Dr. Hill -《Until Dawn 2》岛屿服装和摇头公仔游戏内收藏品
版本包含：
•《Until Dawn 2》
一群暗自心存怀疑的捉鬼者，因一次社交媒体恶作剧意外走红，获得了电视节目的合约。新工作将他们带到偏远荒岛上的一座废弃度假村——一名女子口中充斥着恶魔和种种灵异事件的地方。而这场冒险，或许会让他们的电视首秀一炮而红。
互动式恐怖体验
踏上小岛，投身取材自经典和现代悲剧、暴力及超自然复仇传说的灵异故事。这群年轻的网红主播能否熬过惊魂之夜？他们的命运由您掌控……
您的选择至关重要
在这段扭曲离奇的故事中探索众多路径，您的每一个选择都可能改变前进方向，将角色引向安全……或死亡。谨慎做出对话选择，时刻保持大脑飞速运转，并随时迎接各种意想不到的变数，您的故事将一步步走向多个惊心动魄的结局之一。丰富的选择意味着每一次重玩都可能经历层层转折，并最终导向截然不同的结局走向。
极致拟真
探索风光旖旎的热带小岛，穿行于众多废弃设施之间，借助PlayStation®5的强大功能，每一细节都展现得淋漓尽致、栩栩如生。勇敢踏入不祥的阴影深处，搜寻蛛丝马迹，留意交谈时细微的面部表情变化，并仔细研究精心设计、充满环境叙事感的场景。
恐惧的力量
通过DualSense®无线控制器的触觉反馈和自适应扳机，以感官获得全方位的恐惧体验。仔细端详手中的物品和线索、感受肾上腺素飙升时心脏砰砰作响，并在每次遭遇超自然现象、指尖战栗不已时对抗内心的恐惧。

《地铁2039》是 4A Games 推出的又一款里程碑式第一人称射击游戏，依旧延续了广受好评的重叙事风格。后末日之下，踏上一场直抵莫斯科黑暗腹地的苦痛之旅，在事关地铁存亡的争斗中寻找出路。
时间来到 2039 年。
莫斯科饱受核战争荼毒，仅剩的幸存者转移至地底的地铁隧道，却身陷旷日持久的残酷内战，如此生活了四分之一个世纪。如今，终于出现了一位能够团结所有力量的领袖——不是别人，正是那位有着“猎人”名号、以狂热著称的斯巴达游骑兵。
可和平却并未真正降临。猎人的“新帝国”政权通过宣传手段和恐惧心理实行统治，以发动新战争、对抗地表某个黑暗的可怖敌人为名奴役民众。
城市之外的无垠荒野中，离群索居的“陌路人”深受噩梦困扰，连清醒时都难逃其猛烈攻势。当往事阴魂不散地找上门来，他也只能结束自我放逐，一路深入莫斯科的残垣断壁，去往那个他曾发誓永不踏足的地方……
地铁。
穿行于这片残酷又美丽的土地，沉浸式体验探索、生存、战斗与潜行交织的单人游戏剧情，独自品味史上最震撼的“地铁”冒险。
灵感源自德米特里·格鲁霍夫斯基的全球畅销书籍《地铁》三部曲

立即预购，抢先解锁幸存者套装
标准版
- 《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》本体版
在《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》中迎接终极冒险，再次体验1996年动作冒险类型开山之作。
你将扮演劳拉·克劳馥，凭借过人智慧与矫健身手，探索那些遗忘在时间尽头的奇异遗迹——从秘鲁的丛林，古希腊的废墟，埃及的沙漠，乃至那座被神话笼罩的地中海神秘岛屿。穿越危机四伏的场景，破解致命机关，对抗凶猛的掠食者，追寻那件拥有无穷力量的神器“司祭盎”的碎片。

于预购期间（至2027年2月15日23:59止）购买本作的玩家，可于开始游戏后，从洛亚努镇或缪尔斯港其中一处的宝箱中取得以下装备。
■套装内容
·塔吉亚娜的储钱罐
某位商家孩子的储钱罐。名声阶级为2以下时，战斗后获得的金币提升10%。
·罗宾的英雄指南
记载着怪杰罗宾英雄心得的书籍。名声阶级为2以下时，全体成员于战斗后获得的技术点提升10%。
1995年于日本创下百万销量纪录的《浪漫沙加3》，如今推出完全重制版。
无论是系列作的粉丝，还是首次游玩的玩家，都能尽情享受本作的乐趣。
■故事
……死蚀……
每三百年降临一次的灾难，
会夺走该年诞生的所有生命。
唯独“宿命之子”除外。
距离上一次死蚀过了十余年后，洛亚努侯国爆发了叛乱。
偶然遇见公主莫妮卡的伙伴们成功平定了叛乱，
卻也因此揭開新的陰謀。
曾经肆虐世界的魔王麾下“四魔贵族”，
正企图开启深渊之门……
为了阻止世界走向毁灭，
受到宿命指引的八人之旅就此展开。
■角色
从八位主角中选择一位展开冒险。
·尤里安：充满正义感的西侬村年轻人。
·托马斯：出身名门本特家的青年。
·米迦勒：统治洛亚努侯国的年轻领主。
·哈里特：以“龙卷风”之名闻名的佣兵。
·莎拉：西侬村个性内向的少女。
·艾莲：西侬村个性好强的女性。莎拉的姐姐。
·莫妮卡：洛亚努侯国的公主。
·卡特丽娜：侍奉洛亚努侯家的贵族女性。
此外，还有来自各种不同职业与种族的伙伴登场。
等待着你的是与超过二十位角色相遇的旅程。
■画面
承袭原版小林智美笔下插画与像素图的魅力，同时由Yoshiro Ambe重新设计角色。
城镇、迷宫等场地也全面以3D重新打造。
■自由剧本
要从哪段故事开始，又要依照什么顺序挑战四魔贵族。
玩家的选择将改变冒险的样貌。
请尽情体验因自由探索与选择而诞生的，只属于自己的故事。
■战斗、成长系统
保留战斗中领悟新技能的“闪悟”以及可带来各种效果的“阵形”等经典系统，并采用角色依序行动的时间线战斗，与伙伴携手施展的“连携技”也将使战斗更加热血激昂。
■难度
可从简单、普通、原版三种难度中选择。
简单适合想以剧情为主的玩家，普通适合熟悉RPG的玩家，原版则推荐给想体验忠实重现原作高难度战斗的玩家。
■音乐、语音
原作音乐由伊藤賢治操刀，本作的乐曲重新编曲亦由他亲自统筹。
玩家可于选项中自由切换重编版BGM与原版BGM。
此外，过场事件支持全语音，语音皆是为本作全新录制。

* 与部分附加内容重复。
你听说过深夜电视吗？
主角转学来到新学校，校园里流传着关于“深夜电视”的都市传说。
同时，雾天清晨出现了倒吊的尸体。
追查这两个谜团时，主角一行人面前出现了名为“暗影”的另一个自己。
与觉醒了心灵的力量“人格面具”的同伴们一起阻止案件发生，
踏上追寻真相的旅程吧！
■令人难忘的一年时光正等你开启
你将作为故事的主角暂住到日本的乡下小镇稻羽市，在这里开始一段高中生活，度过无可替代的一年时光。要学习还是要参加社团活动，是去唱卡拉OK还是选择恋爱，如何度过多彩的每一天，完全由你决定。
■追查凶杀案与深夜电视之谜
宁静的小镇上出现了倒吊的尸体。据说受害者曾出现在都市传说中可在雨夜收看的“深夜电视”中。主角一行人在追查事件与传闻的过程中发现了电视中的异世界。而他们在那里觉醒的力量正是揭开“真相”的关键——心灵的力量“人格面具”。
■攻略充满危险的异世界
与异世界的怪物“暗影”展开回合制指令战斗。面对各种各样的敌人时，人格面具和技能的搭配至关重要。新战斗机制“全力暴打”触发后，可以无视抗性与消耗，连续施放强力技能。收集新的人格面具，找到适合自己的战斗方式吧。
■新增唤起旧日回忆的剧情
晴朗的天空、夕阳下的河堤、被雨水打湿的路面。稻羽市带着往日余温的风景将以精致的画面呈现出来。在寻找案件线索的同时，不妨也听听镇上的居民有什么困扰吧。有时也会在交流中萌生“情谊”。你与他人结下的“情谊”必将化为你的“力量”。

现在预购《神鬼寓言》，即可在游戏发售时获得预购奖励内容包，内含：
• 小鸡装扮（外观服饰）
• 野花花束（游戏内礼物）
• 玩具小鸡（游戏内礼物）
• 司康饼加果酱野餐篮（游戏内礼物）
现在预购《神鬼寓言》，即可获得预购奖励内容包，内含喜感十足的小鸡装扮以及一系列精美的游戏内礼物：野花花束、玩具小鸡和司康饼加果酱野餐篮。合理利用这些道具来提升你的声望，决定阿尔比昂的居民对你的看法。*
踏入这款沉浸式开放世界动作角色扮演游戏，成为你想要成为的那种英雄。在这里，你的每一次选择都会改变未来的旅程。名声高于一切，幸福结局需要用双手争取。
传奇游戏系列的新篇章
《神鬼寓言》以惊艳新作重启人气系列。你将扮演这一时代里出现的第一位英雄，探索生机勃勃的阿尔比昂大陆。这里充满了奇特的人物、黑色幽默，还有小鸡......很多很多只鸡。这一作不仅仅是对前作的怀旧，更是在一片美丽而鲜活的开放世界里展开的全新篇章。
成为你想要成为的那种英雄
自定义英雄外观，挥舞强大的武器，在近战、远程与魔法战斗之间灵活切换。迎战强盗、野兽和各种生物，还有全新敌人以及祟精、狍狡、巨魔等玩家钟爱的经典怪物。你的名声将随着你的力量一同增长。
打造非凡人生
在激烈的战斗之外，你还可以在这片生生不息的世界里展开奇妙人生，雕刻自我。成为房东或铁匠，赚得盆满钵满；与村民来一场（或者三场）浪漫邂逅，生养一群孩子，看着你的名声与日俱增，代代相传。成为英雄的感觉有点像是成为明星......不过是那种会佩戴刀剑、偶尔会与喷火巨鸡战斗的明星。
你的选择将改变世界
在阿尔比昂，英雄的名声就是一切。高尚的功绩，或是不太道德的决定，都会影响你与每一位村民的关系，甚至可能会影响你周围的世界。谁的意见最重要？选择权在你手中......不过，相应的后果也会由你承担。“成为英雄意味着什么”，这个答案就由你来撰写。
幸福结局需要用双手争取。

可获得两款猫猫专用饰品。
[早期购买特典]

可获得两款猫猫专用饰品，以及可在游戏前期派上用场的消耗道具。
【组合内容】
·药屋素雅配饰套装
新增猫猫专用配饰套装，内含两件饰品。
·新手配药助力礼包
新增配药材料包，可用于调配游戏前期任务所需的道具。
那帖药，终将化为毒。
【关于本作】
以药为引，以推理破局——揭开一切真相的宫廷推理奇谭。
“五大谜团”与“五重诅咒”相互交织，谱写出《药屋少女的呢喃》的全新故事。
怪异频发，阴谋迭起，在后宫、花街与市井间不断蔓延。
出身花街的药师少女猫猫循迹追查，最终所揭开的“真假皇弟”真相，究竟是——
### 证据搜集与推理
通过对话与实地调查获得的零散线索将记录于手记中，并在梳理案情环节整合为清晰的关系图。推理环节需出示与组合证据，在审慎抉择中体验步步惊心的博弈。
### 采集药材与配药
在地图中采集素材，混合药材并斟酌配比以完成配药。素材的种类与品质不仅影响配药小游戏的难度，也将左右最终成品的药效。
【剧情概要】
花街的药师猫猫初入后宫成为侍女后不久，后宫接连发生了被称作“五大谜团”的离奇事件——
没有面孔的宦官、夜夜传出哀声的库房、一夜间被染红的衣物……
种种异象频生，一时间，后宫人心惶惶。
受后宫管事壬氏所托，猫猫开始着手调查“五大谜团”。
凭借药理知识与敏锐观察，她善用配药与交涉之术，一步步搜集线索，破解谜案。
在回家省亲途中，猫猫结识了江湖艺人冠宇。一纸药方的机缘，却让她卷入冠宇深藏的“烦恼”之中。
时光流转，子之一族的叛乱方平，王都却再起波澜。“五重诅咒”的传闻悄然蔓延，终至血案发生。
猫猫偶然行经案发现场，竟亲眼目睹“蒙面皇弟”现身。
壬氏虽矢口否认，但王都之中流言四起，甚嚣尘上，更出现公然拥立“蒙面皇弟”的神秘集团，王都局势愈发扑朔迷离。
那位“蒙面皇弟”的真实身份究竟为何？五大谜团与五重诅咒之间，又暗藏怎样的因缘？
一段牵涉尘封禁忌秘史的宏大故事，即将拉开序幕——

s.desc:
■预购特典
·召唤魔晶石：机械陆行鸟＆莫古力
赌上星球未来，与萨菲罗斯展开最终决战。
足以毁灭星球的陨石带来威胁，巨大的星球守护者兵器即将觉醒，战火也愈发激烈。在迈向终焉的世界中，克劳德与伙伴们将挺身而出，为了拯救星球，也为了替这场漫长的战斗画下句点。
本作是“FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE”项目三部曲的完结篇，将以系列史上最大的规模，描绘壮阔的冒险。驾驶飞空艇翱翔天际，探索广阔世界，与伙伴们一同挑战全面进化的战斗。未知的旅程，终将抵达终点。
所有命运，都将在此交汇。
■驾驶飞空艇翱翔天际，展开前所未有的冒险
搭乘飞空艇海温德在空中四处航行，自由地探索广大的世界。
亲自选择降落地点，使用降落伞从空中一跃而下。穿梭于壮丽的大地、都市与秘境之间，展开全新的冒险。
■伙伴们终于全员集结
全新可操作角色文森特·瓦伦丁与希德·海温德也将参战。
擅长华丽枪战动作的文森特，以及能熟练运用长枪、在地面与空中灵活作战的希德加入后，个性鲜明的伙伴们终于全数集结。各角色截然不同的战斗风格与能力，也将大幅拓展战术选择。
■更加精炼的动作与战略性
融合即时动作与指令选择的系列独有战斗系统再次进化。
玩家可一边切换操作角色，一边选择指令，灵活运用强大的能力、联手招式与召唤兽的力量来迎战强敌。与巨大的星球守护者兵器之间的战斗，也将以前所未有的规模呈现。
■丰富的自定义要素
通过武器、装备、技能与魔晶石的搭配组合，玩家可自由地自定义角色的能力。
此外，全新系统“战术衣”可通过让角色穿上专属服装，解锁全新的能力与技能，进一步拓展各角色的战斗方式。除了享受外观变化的乐趣，也能打造专属于自己的战术与游玩风格。

击溃诸神，为艾尔塔奋起而战
你被族人选中，踏上寻找失落神明的旅程，却意外流落到一颗危机四伏的星球。归途已断，你只能与新结识的龙形伙伴并肩作战，奋力杀出重围。重创强敌，击败诸神，无论前方有何阻碍，皆以战斗闯破重重险阻，一路杀出生天
《艾尔塔：逆神》是一款令人肾上腺素飙升的动作平台游戏，由《层层梦境》的独立开发团队Afterburner Studios打造。尽情体验自由近战、流畅平台跳跃与科幻探索玩法，为了恢复神明的力量与拯救族人，踏上神圣征程。
- 投身激烈近战，尽显战斗技艺；武术与魔法，杀机四射，击得敌人溃不成军
- 探索三个错综复杂的科幻世界，灵活衔接各种移动能力，抵达全新区域，发掘隐藏其中的秘密
- 追随先祖足迹，习得全新战斗招式与灵巧特技，与艾尔塔一同磨练技艺，不断变强
- 击溃迫害并将族人流放数百年的诸神，帮助艾尔塔完成复仇，为更加美好的未来开辟道路
